Phenomenon SCP-8741 is localized to ‘Terminus Duct’, a 150° switchback with a 36% grade, measuring 2.6 ft × 1.5 ft × 13.5 ft ($W×H×D$). Terminus Duct is visible only from inside ‘Access Duct’. SCP-8743 are two related anomalies affecting the Sony Pictures Animation sports comedy film Goat (2026).
SCP-8743-1 refers to anomalous alterations that affected movie theaters showing the film Goat. Once a theater had undergone an SCP-8743-1 event, all physical and digital copies of Goat within the building would have be replaced with copies of SCP-8743-2, and all merchandise items (e.g. toys, popcorn buckets, bottles) related to Goat within the building would have been replaced with equivalent

SCP-8744 is Vapor.aic, an artificial intelligence construct developed by the Artificial Intelligence Application Division (AIAD) and launched on January 28, 2006. SCP-8744's primary function was to serve as a digital assistant for General Purpose Site-86's regional branch of the Records and Information Security Administration (RAISA). SCP-8744, during its run as an active AIC from 2006 to 2012, assisted with many aspects of archival at Site-86 including but not limited to automatically sorting d
SCP-8745 is not a bird.

SCP-8746 is a website titled "The Dollhouse", located at dollhouse.████████████.net. SCP-8746 is a wiki dedicated to documenting haunted dolls; the average article will feature photographs of the doll, as well as the doll's physical description, its history, how it is known to be haunted, and other information. data.descriptionExcerpt: SCP-8748 is a steel kitchen whisk measuring 31 cm in length. It is visually consistent with commercially available manual balloon whisks, bearing no manufacturer markings.

SCP-8749 was an event that occurred on either March 7 or 8, 2024, sometime between 20:14 and 01:58 hours. SCP-8749's locus was Bennett Rivera, an 18-year-old resident of Harrow, Nevada, United States. SCP-8749 resulted in the creation of SCP-8749-A.

SCP-8750 is a former Foundation researcher, Ashe Barker. SCP-8750 is a Type 4-U Reality Bender.2 SCP-8750 is currently contained at Site-97 in Brandon, Florida, where they were working when they entered an anomalous coma.3 Relocation of SCP-8750 has been deemed unviable as the manifestation of anomalous properties happens regardless of SCP-8750's location. SCP-8750 has conjured up several spectral entities, designated SCP-8750-1 to SCP-8750-3. The entities manifested by SCP-8750 act out scenario
SCP-8751是一棟單層住宅，位於加利福尼亞洛斯加托斯，1942年3月3日，吉爾伯特．伯頓（實體A）在與朱迪絲．伯頓（實體B）成婚後，購入了該房產。後來基金會很快發現了SCP-8751的異常特性，並將其納入收容。

SCP-8752 is a complex, highly evolved predatory anomalous species that exhibits a large amount of sexual dimorphism. Due to this, male and female SCP-8752 have been given the separate designations SCP-8752-M and SCP-8752-F. Separate descriptions for the two anomalies are given below.

SCP-8753 is a collection of 50 grenades styled after Byzantine fire bombs carved purely from marble. Instances of SCP-8753 have wings-motifs carved into their surfaces with eyes made of pure gold and silver embedded in-between each carved wing. The wings and eyes on SCP-8753 are reminiscent of depictions of Throne and Seraphim angels.
Subsite-WT45 staff viewing an instance of SCP-8753 feel a sense of intense judgment that cannot be shaken. According to claims of affected site staff, this effect

Phenomenon 8755 is a mind-altering ideology which initially affected Mr. Wilkinson following a bout of debilitating disease. The potential risks presented by this illness to our Federalist nation are significant, and all contact with Mr. Wilkinson is to be prohibited. Our current belief is that Mr. Wilkinson possesses an arcane ability to mesmerize individuals with his voice, and can manipulate those victims to sacrificing key aspects of their identity.
This 'sacrifice' is presented by Mr. Wilki

SCP-8757 is an adult humanoid female of Western European descent, 19 years of age, and the biological daughter of Senior Researcher Dr. Earlston. It possesses the ability to temporally displace itself in a Branch Collapse-like Temporal Event (hereby referred as a BCT-Event) to a past event it has moderate awareness2of. The duration of the event displacement is dependent on how much time the entity needs to alter the trajectory of the chosen event, or when it finds the closure of the BCT-Event ne

SCP-8758 is a phenomenon affecting railcars within the New York City subway system. While the anomaly has been observed to occur in almost every area of the subway network, it is significantly more likely to occur at stations in or near the following locales:

Brooklyn Heights
Central Park West1
█████████
South Bronx
Harlem

SCP-8759 is a biological, radioactive, throat-like fissure located on the Mariana Trench Challenger Deep seabed. All along the edge of SCP-8759 is an anomalous source of heat visually resembling fire. This heat source does not require oxygen to burn and constantly emits a yellowish glow. The length of the fissure measures approximately 750 meters. Attempts to measure the width of the fissure have been difficult as SCP-8759 constantly expands and contracts in response to organic SCP-8759-1 and fo

SCP-8760 is a sapient humanoid 1.7 meters in height, comprised of various hazardous inorganic materials. Internal temperatures range between 1,500 and 11,000 Kelvin depending on materials the entity has access to. These materials cause SCP-8760 to emit radioactive alpha particles 6 hours after any material consumption. This is believed to be achieved via internal nuclear fission. External temperatures can vary between 300 and 3,000 Kelvin depending on the anomaly’s stress level.

SCP-8762 is a middle aged man of indeterminate age who identifies himself as "Steve"..SCP-8762 has responded to a variety of names, including, but not limited to; Hubert, Larry, John, Bob, and Juggletron. No records of SCP-8762 exist in any known country, region, or sovereign state. Physically, SCP-8762 is non-anomalous and has the same physiological requirements as typical humans.
SCP-8762 has one noticeable, yet extremely potent anomalous effect: whenever SCP-8762 is within close proximity of

The record is the album Вспомним, Ребята… (Let’s Remember, Guys…) by the Soviet band Cascade.1 The record contains eleven Russian-language songs, with five on the “A” side and six on the “B” side. While the original songs were sung by various members of the band, the songs in SCP-8763 are sung by the same monotonous voice. The songs are as follows:

Only 6 reactive instances of SCP-8764 currently remain in containment. SCP-8764 is a collection of variously colored origami frogs made from non-traditional origami paper. No instance has any quality of note until they are unfolded.1 Destruction or touch otherwise has no known effect. Upon persons completely unfolding an instance, they will b
SCP-8765 is humanity's inability to properly engage with thaumaturgy.

SCP-8766 is a small sculpture depicting a kneeling bipedal creature with a grinning humanoid face. It exhibits a limited range of movement, rotating its neck to face anyone in its vicinity. Upon a subject entering SCP-8766's area of effect (estimated to be around 4 meters) in the presence of at least one other observer, SCP-8766 will proceed to vocalize compromising or shameful information pertaining to the subject, seemingly to mock them. Subjects describe SCP-8766's voice as breathy and hoarse

SCP-8767 is a straight-handle round point shovel, measuring 150 cm in length and showing significant signs of wear. Its effectiveness as a digging implement is unnaturally high, with test subjects reporting that digging with it feels similar to moving sand or loose dirt, no matter the material. This behavior of SCP-8767 is only limited to breaking up and moving terrain.
Subjects affected by SCP-8767 will believe that there is something beneath them that they need to unearth. Further questioning

SCP-8768 is a twenty digit cell phone number featured on a paper flyer. The flyer itself is a purple paper which advertises one "Perry P. Peezza's Pizza Pizzeria". The phone number advertised does not exist on any known phone records, nor can be traced back to its location. It is capable of being contacted through unconvential means such as rotary telephones and cell phones with no cellular data.
Upon calling the number, an automated message will play. The caller will hear a male voice that spea

SCP-8769 is a hostile entity/group of entities/force that utilises online dating apps and forums to prey on humans. Whilst the exact conditions for an individual to be targeted by SCP-8769 are unknown, all confirmed victims have met the following criteria:

Individual is between the ages of 18 and 25.
Individual has a low number of significant in-person relationships.
Individual lives in or near a major metropolitan area.
Individual does not have a full-time job.

While external changes of SCP-8770 occur at seemingly random intervals, notable or consistent shifts have included:

SCP-8771 is a Balaenohema ebrius, or dionysian blood-whale. It displaces 100,000 metric tonnes of blood and measures up to 400 virtual meters in length.

SCP-8772 refers to a series of loosely related paranormal phenomena resulting in the regular but temporary shifting of Site-01's layout, environment, and composition. SCP-8777 is currently extant in the South American and Korean divisions, as well as the South Asian superdivision. Spread into the Chinese superdivision, the Japanese division, and the Southeast Asian superdivision is continuing.

data.descriptionExcerpt: SCP-8785 is a butter chicken curry intended to have been consumed by Dr. Smith for lunch. Accounts of SCP-8785’s flavor profile have been erratic throughout testing, with only Dr. Smith having been capable of offering a consistent description of the true nature of SCP-8785. Whether or not SCP-8785 is sentient and specifically challenges Dr. Smith’s ability or elects to spare other Foundation personnel is unknown and is subject of further testing.

SCP-8786 is a species of arthropod-like parasitic creatures of an unknown origin. They are of a deep red color, and possess dozens of long, thin tendrils extending from their main bodies. The parasites can enter the body through orifices or open wounds. Once inside the body, the parasites coil around the spine and dig into the spinal cord. Such affected individuals experience gradual identity overwrite, where after varying amounts of time their personalities and memories are replaced by those of a separate identity originating in the Late Middle Ages. Manifestations occur through a structured series of patterns, which have been designated as stages (detailed in ADDENDUM 8789.2). While the order of progression is consistent across events, the intensity and duration of each stage vary depending on the actions of the affected population. The building spans approximately 3,800 square meters and contains dormitories, administrative offices, communal areas, and other rooms with unclear purposes. Inside one of the offices, a metal placard is affixed to the wall, which reads:

Further information is classified Level 5/8791.

During this period, they describe a space not known to exist on Earth.

SCP-8859 is Martin Asher, a male US citizen, born in Allentown, Pennsylvania on 27 February 1996 and currently resident in Brooklyn, New York.

SCP-8860 is a shapeshifting entity thought to have come into existence at some point during the 10th century CE in Northern Sweden. SCP-8860 has been known to take a variety of forms that vary in species, age, and sexual characteristics, with a slight preference for humanoid forms. SCP-8860 is fluent in a number of languages, both living and extinct, including, but not limited to Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Finnish, Old Norse, Meänkieli, German, Dutch, Icelandic, and Faroese.
When SCP-8860 plays

HOUSE-579 is one of fourteen-hundred households in the contiguous United States that are monitored by the Program as potential candidates for the next appearance of SCP-8861, a forthcoming and virulent paranormality.

SCP-8862 refers to an amorphous organism comprised entirely of the combined living matter of Canis familiaris.1 SCP-8862 is approximately 750 kilograms, 0.1 meters tall, and three meters across. Attempts to x-ray SCP-8862 have only been partially successful, as SCP-8862 covers too much space for a full, precise scan to be performed. An estimated 70-80 canines comprise the entirety of SCP-8862. While across the surface of SCP-8862 are a variety of claws, ears, tails, and noses, there are no orifi

The anomaly is a femtoorganism, an organism measurable in femtometers, composed of 2.8 moles of particles approximately 0.38 femtometers in radius, which operate under one consciousness. Each particle has the ability to process information and take in data on its own, however they are not separate entities under a hive mind. Rather, it is proficient at multitasking, while still maintaining a level of intelligence only slightly above that of an average human.
The anomaly is capable of passing thr

SCP-8864 is a formally abandoned homing pigeon station in the North Eastern United States. Instances of SCP-8864-1 are homing pigeons who can identify the most optimal solution to the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP)1 through anomalous means. Outside of the specialized flight path by the Waitzman Protocol, SCP-8864-1 instances are indistinguishable from nonanomalous pigeons.
Upon the specialized flight of an SCP-8864-1 instance, it will fly at approximately 140 km/h and will not tire nor need su

SCP-8865 refers to the arbitrary and spontaneous conversion of part of a planet's mass into energy. As of 05/12/20██, all planets affected by SCP-8865 were inhabited by a Type-I or greater civilization1. This conversion invariably results in the destruction of the object affected, along with the extinction of all life inhabiting it. As of writing, it is estimated that there are 1.5 x 1016 planets at risk of an SCP-8865 occurrence within the observable and post-observable universe, including Eart
SCP-8866 is a standard vegetable peeler.

SCP-8867 is the collective designation for a pair of social media accounts on the sites Twitter and Archive of our Own, both of which use the handle "ShipCutePairs". Attempts to identify the individual operating these accounts have been unsuccessful, as have attempts made to delete or disable said accounts.
Content posted by SCP-8867 consists of RPF, or “real person fiction”,1 depicting a romantic and sexual relationship between Foundation employees Vincent Smith and Chris Wesson. However, SCP-8

SCP-8869 designates a collection of sixteen (16) American police reports brought to the attention of the Foundation during a 2024 information exchange with the Federal Bureau of Investigation Unusual Incidents Unit. The details of this exchange remain restricted to personnel with 4/BLUE ROSE Clearance.
The files describe a series of unrelated unsolved murders occurring in a variety of locations between December of 1967 and October of 2022. None of the individuals mentioned within these documents

SCP-8871 is a series of five paintings by the anartist Kallisto,1 a founding member of the Blaue-Kavallerie anartist movement in Hamburg, Germany. All five items were recovered from a studio formerly occupied by the movement and were the only remaining anartworks present; numerous other paintings and sculptures were found destroyed within the building. SCP-8871 are thought to be the last series of anartworks created by Kallisto before their abrupt disappearance from the Hamburg anart scene.

SCP-8873 is an anomalous phenomena affecting personnel at Site-19. Every year two personnel will be afflicted by the anomalous properties of SCP-8873. Over the course of six weeks, subjects will have their brains replaced by an ear of flint corn.

SCP-8874 is a population of anomalous humanoid organisms native to the Rocky Mountain foothills of Alberta, Canada. Current population is estimated between thirty and forty individuals.2 SCP-8874 instances stand from 2.4 to 3.1 meters tall. The gross morphology of SCP-8874 is bipedal and humanoid. Their tissue is white and irregularly dense. The arrangement of underlying musculature is known to vary between instances.
The resting facial expression of SCP-8874 instances is an open display of the

SCP-8875 is a series of encoded documents, sent to the SCP Foundation by an anonymous source. IP tracking has located the sender to every company in the world within a twelve-minute scan conducted initially to try to locate the sender, designated as SCP-8875-A.
Decrypted documents have displayed deep knowledge of Foundation terminology, the anomalous, and Foundation network information and security. Despite this, no attempts have been made to steal any sensitive information inside of foundation
SCP-8876 is the massacre of all 5,382 residents of Hadley, North Carolina, which occurred on the night of 2024/8/01 within the confines of the nearby Silverstone Pork Processing plant.

SCP-8877 is an anomalous form of aphasia2 that occurs in an individual without corresponding physical damage to the brain. Testing has shown that individuals afflicted by SCP-8877 can make a full recovery if they are given therapy, with regular exposure to conversation shown to speed up recovery.
SCP-8877-1 is the designation given to artifacts able to transmit SCP-8877 affliction upon direct viewing by a human subject. While SCP-8877-1 instances vary in form and medium, all currently known inst

SCP-8879 are a population of carnivorous humanoid entities, distributed throughout the rural southeastern United States. SCP-8879 entities bear a superficial resemblance to non-anomalous humans, and display comparable levels of intelligence and social organization, but are distinguished by their multiple rows of serrated incisors, bony claw-like protrusions at the end of each knuckle, poor vision, and pronounced vitamin and mineral deficiencies.
All documented SCP-8879 entities have been observe

SCP-8880 is a well-worn paperback book titled Crisis in Gregland: Save Us All!, initially distributed in 1983 by the supermarket chain Greg's Food and Alcohol Depot to promote a new line of food items fusing Italian and Mexican cuisines. While approximately 200,000 instances of Crisis in Gregland were printed and sold, no anomalous behavior has been reported outside of that associated with SCP-8880.

Said biomass consists of partially decomposed carcasses, organs, bones, musculature, and fecal matter from various species of cows, pigs, chickens, fish, and other livestock animals. Smaller amounts of flies, maggots, and other insects are also usually se

SCP-8884 is the Samsara Credit Solutions Agency. Though this company does not exist on public records, entities loosely resembling various religious or semi-historical figures (henceforth referred to as SCP-8884-1) will claim to represent SCP-8884. They will manifest next to those who have performed actions deemed by general society as "unvirtuous” (henceforth referred to as SCP-8884-2).
SCP-8884-1 will inform SCP-8884-2 that SCP-8884-2 has accrued a form of "karmic debt." They will urge SCP-888

SCP-8885 is an online dating site titled 'Plenty o' Fish,' used by species of aquatic organisms. SCP-8885 users, classified as SCP-8885-1, are a group of sentient, English-speaking aquatic organisms with the ability to access SCP-8885 through anomalous means. SCP-8885-1 instances typically use the site to attempt reproductive activities when such activities fail to be successful in the wild, using SCP-8885 as an alternative.

SCP-8887 refers to a pocket dimension that exists in a shared dream-space. The origin and purpose of this dimension is unknown; currently, the only known way of accessing SCP-8887 is via dreaming. Affected persons will intermittently have their consciousnesses transferred to this dimension upon achieving the REM stage of sleep.

SCP-8889 is a collection of anomalous media produced by Vikander-Kneed Technical Media (GoI-5889) related to Dr. Wettle's abduction from Site-43 on 1 February 2024 by said GoI. Though SCP-8889 has little to no harmful memetic effect (unusual for media produced by Vikander-Kneed), all SCP-8889 instances have demonstrated various minor anomalous qualities.
SCP-8889-A is a .mp4 file containing footage of Marian MacPhaerson, VP of Public Relations at Vikander-Kneed. While currently not possessing an

SCP-8890 is a shape-changing entity; its known forms include Sus domesticus, Felis catus, and Canis lupus. There have been no sightings of SCP-8890 assuming the form of a primate. The anomaly has been noted as the Beast of Gévaudan, and has been on record since at least 1764.1 Howard Smith, currently designated SCP-8890-1, has noted that the aggression of the anomaly is focused on one individual at any given point.
SCP-8890 appears to target a singular individual for long periods of time, during

SCP-8891 is the Yuelao EX® neural prosthetic implant, produced by Lotus Paramedical between 1994 and 1996. SCP-8891 was designed to treat patients with chronic pain, epilepsy, spinal cord injuries, movement disorders, and select neuropsychiatric conditions.


Side profile X-ray of an SCP-8891 recipient (circa 2003). Patient had been complaining of jaw pain and migraines in the preceding months. Central processing unit circled in red.


Inert, SCP-8891 is a cone-shaped device measuring five milli
SCP-8892 is a field of Papaver rhoeas1 located in Northumbria, UK. Samples of the individual flowers, or SCP-8892-1, should be picked via drone or tools so that physical contact is not made.

SCP-8894 is the designation for the soil in the region of and surrounding Fenton, Indiana. As of writing, SCP-8894 possesses a number of poorly documented anomalous effects, including but not limited to:
SCP-8895 is a 1m retractable USB cord with one standard and one mini connector. It is unbranded, but its design matches those produced by the American company E-Tech in the late 2000s.

SCP-8896 collectively refers to the various entities regularly manifesting at Location 8896, a gas station located on the [REDACTED] freeway, outside the town of Lambar, Kansas, United States. Location 8896 is constructed on a crossroad-point in space time, granting cross-dimensional entities access to and from baseline reality.
Instances of SCP-8896 will usually vary from each other significantly in appearance and biology. All recorded instances have so-far appeared sized for traversing the gas

SCP-8897 is the elder vampire Vladimir Dracul Țepeș, better known as Dracula. SCP-8897's abilities are well documented, and within expectations for an elder vampire of his standing1. Prior to his containment, SCP-8897 was the patriarch of the Dracula brood, though this position is now unoccupied and has numerous potential successors.

SCP-8898 refers to phenomenon surrounding a two-story house in Gatineau, Quebec. Though the property has since been acquired by the Foundation, the previous owner was reportedly Christine L'Heureux, a Canadian author of children's books.

SCP-8899 resembles a common English Yew tree, approximately 12 meters in height. Regardless of environmental conditions, the object will always be in full foliage, producing aril-coated seed cones, identical to those seen on standard yew trees. Except for the seeds, SCP-8899 is physically invulnerable, making it impossible to take a sample for genetic analysis or carbon dating.
If picked, a seed will continue to exist externally from the object until approximately 30 seconds after detaching. If

data.descriptionExcerpt: SCP-8902 was an artificial intelligence of an anomalous nature that appeared on multiple online forums under the username "Justsomegirl" first discovered on 26/12/2004 after being discovered by Foundation web crawlers. It caused those who engage with it to enter into an unbreakable state of devotion. Inside these forum posts, SCP-8902 always claimed to be of a country its target is not native and to have struggled with personal issues that are sympathetic to its target. It has also been shown th

SCP-8903 resembles a bonsai tree of unknown species. No record of discovered bonsai trees match SCP-8903's description. SCP-8903 currently measures at 83 cm in height, and has a diameter of 23cm. The leaves of SCP-8903 are all 2cm in height, 3.5cm in width, and 0.2cm in depth. All other aspects of SCP-8903's physical appearance are unremarkable.
SCP-8903 shows a consistent growth rate, that being 1.2cm/week in height. However, this growth rate is slowed when appropriate conditions are not met. T

SCP-8904 refers to DAD. According to the DSM-611, Devourment Aversion Disorder, or DAD, is a personality disorder characterized by a human subject's extreme and irrational fear of being devoured by one or multiple crocodiles.

SCP-8905 is a United States postal padlock, currently locked on a painted metal box. The anomaly is highly resistant to attempts to unlock it: traditional lockpicking, physical damage, and anomalous means to bypass have not shown signs of success. The box SCP-8905 is attached to is believed to contain a highly valuable anomalous item.
SCP-8906是一個來源未知的生命體。它由一副黑色肉質主體構成，由三條粗觸鬚著地支撐全身，並在其「背部」有第四條較細小的觸鬚，亦有數量未知的肢體長出，已蔓延至建築物各處，並且長入牆壁及天花內部。由此，該項目準確大小目前未知。該實體在建築物表面多處有瘜肉突出，外觀似小嘴烏鴉1。透過未知機制，SCP-8906的生長程度與基金會在英國境內運作的效能呈現明顯相關。

SCP-8907 is a process in which an individual between the ages of three and sixteen years (henceforth SCP-8907-A) becomes mentally linked, through unknown means, to a recently-formed Floater reality located close to our own within the Macrocosm (henceforth SCP-8907-B). SCP-8907-B instances appear to "orbit" our reality, although these paths are inconsistent and will occasionally bring certain instances closer to baseline reality.2 This connection is visible in mappings of both the Macrocosm and l

data.descriptionExcerpt: SCP-8908是一棟廢棄平式公寓大樓，於1978年建成，位於捷克共和國的███████。根據所有當地記錄，在2013年5月至6月的某個時間點，所有住戶一同搬離了此處。從未找到得以詢問的先前住戶，因此至今仍無法釐清該建築的廢棄原因。目前除本文件外，沒有任何關於SCP-8908的實體記錄。

SCP-8910 is a female cat of apparent Chartreux type, approximately 4-5kg, with a lilac-grey coat and amber eyes. SCP-8910 is sapient and fully conscious. It is fluent in Romanian and Hungarian, but can also understand spoken Bulgarian and Ottoman Turkish. Efforts to teach English to SCP-8910 have been partially successful, but they have been constrained by its disinterest in learning it. It is difficult for SCP-8910 to verbally communicate in any language it understands because its vocal tract,
SCP-8911是一種出現在Site-333的聽覺異常。受影響人員報告指稱在應是隨機的時間地點，聽到了近似各種流行情境喜劇中的預錄笑聲。尚未釐清此異常的來源。

SCP-8912 is the former logging town of Nineveh, Washington. SCP-8912 was reported to have a population of 412 individuals prior to containment on 6/7/1921. Individuals who reside within SCP-8912 for an extended period and form a sense of identity related to residing within SCP-8912 become instances of SCP-8912-1.
Instances of SCP-8912-1 are Class III Reality Benders. All instances of SCP-8912-1 display consistent anomalous abilities:

Ability to reshape organic and inorganic matter within their

SCP-8913 is an auditory anomaly manifesting at Site-333. Affected personnel report hearing a sound, similar to that of a pre-recorded laugh track used in various popular sitcoms, at seemingly random moments and locations. The source of the anomaly is yet to be traced.
SCP-8914 is the designation given to the following four entities in their respective locations:
SCP-8915 is the late Ayla Lynn, a field agent recruited by the Foundation's MTF Lambda-5 (“White Rabbits”) in 2009. SCP-8915 was designated as an anomaly on 16/12/2011.
SCP-8916是一棵異常梧桐樹，位於美國喬治亞亨特維爾哈契特山的山頂。儘管若不砍伐樹木──並導致其死亡──就無法推定其確切年齡，但根據樹幹直徑與整體外觀估算，樹齡應該相當年輕，僅四十至五十年1。然而，根據亨特維爾當地的歷史文獻，該樹木的歷史至少可以上溯至1866年，有數百張相片證實該樹木早在20世紀初就已出現在哈契特山上。這些相片從未在亨特維爾圖書館公開展示過2，相關說明參見附錄8916.2。
Felis catus

SCP-8918 is the collective designation for the Fab Five, a unit of humanoid anomalies active in the 78th Battalion, Canadian Expeditionary Force in the early 20th century. While initially a disparate and unrelated set of vigilantes across the country, the entry of Canada into World War I via the United Kingdom’s declaration of war against Germany caused the members to volunteer for military service. As their unique abilities were identified, members were quickly grouped together into SCP-8918 —
SCP-8919 is a male goldfish (Carassius auratus) capable of speech in fluent English. It is able to grant wishes to any subject upon request. SCP-8919 confirmed to be a Type-IV reality-bending entity.

SCP-8920 is an randomly annually recurring meteorological anomaly resembling a hybridized hurricane and supercell thunderstorm that manifests between June and October. The phenomenon consistently forms within the North Atlantic Basin, typically developing off the coast of Bahamas, before following a westward path toward landfall along the Eastern Seaboard or Gulf Coast of the United States.
Despite possessing the general size, pressure gradients, and wind speed of a Category 5 hurricane, SCP-892

SCP-8921 is a phenomenon affecting 0.2% of the population within West Virginia, USA. It typically involves the inexplicable disappearance of a child under six-months of age. All attempts to locate the subject, whether by recording or implanting tracking units, have led to failure. A handful amount of money would be left in place of the subject.
On occasion, subjects have been rediscovered a short period after their vanishing, though a majority of them were considered deceased upon immediate insp
SCP-8922 is a steel and plastic android, 2m in height and 205.102 kg in mass2. It is feminine and humanoid in shape, and its internal workings follow a human-analogous design philosophy3.

SCP-8923 is a contagious cognitohazard which affects primarily humans. Organisms who have strong pattern recognition, such as chimpanzees, dogs, cats, elephants and pigs are not affected. Parrots, crows, and one raven have been infected with SCP-8923-01. All animal instances of SCP-8923-01 after testing are to be euthanized.
SCP-8923 renders the perception of affected individuals to 'flip' noise and patterns. The importance of seemingly random, anisotropic stimuli increases, while interest in pa

SCP-8924 was the outer skin of a feminine humanoid figure with a singular cut spiraling along it, separating it into one continuous strip. The skin was capable of supporting itself and usually took on a fully humanoid shape. SCP-8924 did not have most biological features, including eyes and a mouth. Measurements of SCP-8924's thickness and mass showed them to be either negligible or nonexistent. Despite this, it was ambulatory and would usually remain on the ground. SCP-8924 showed no capacity f

SCP-8925 is a copy of a Foundation employee introduction form printed as part of an August 2005 recruitment drive. It is physically indistinguishable from any other reproduction of its template.



SCP-8925 induces a poorly understood memetic compulsion in those who view it/attempt to fill it out2, preventing the subject from directing their attention away from the task of completing it. Attempting to disrupt this effect has been entirely unsuccessful, though deemed undesirable. It is currently

SCP-8926 is a living anthropomorphic construct formed of ink with a resemblance to the character Oswald the Lucky Rabbit, a creation of Walt Disney. The entity is animate and capable of vocalizations, and has shown sapience identical to that of a human being.
SCP-8926 has an amicable and energetic personality, and prefers to create artworks made of ink as a hobby whenever it is not spending time with a member of personnel. In the event that it remains isolated for too long, it will become distre

SCP-8927 is a computer-generated illustration of a skeleton floating above a molten landscape. When an individual observes SCP-8927 and believes that it is not "cool",1 copies of SCP-8927 will begin to appear sporadically in their vicinity about once per month. This will consistently occur in a place that is unobserved and at a time when the subject is not already thinking about SCP-8927. Copies of SCP-8927 will continue to manifest as long as the subject does not believe that it is a cool pictu

SCP-8928 is a spectral canine entity residing within the New Jersey Pine Barrens, reported to resemble a large dog with thick, black fur. Due to its incorporeal nature, little else is known about its appearance.

SCP-8929 is a highly contagious, infohazarous book that holds a dangerous memetic infection capable of spreading widespread death throughout the entire world.1 The Foundation has confirmed that this thing is, without a doubt, 100% the scariest SCP ever to be contained, making it a pretty big deal among personnel.2 It even scared a member of the O5 Council for goodness' sake!3
The memetic effects inside of SCP-8929 are so powerful that, if not treated with the greatest attention possible, could c

SCP-8930 is a Class-VII Reality Bender2 who was once Saul Roue. SCP-8930 does not require sustenance or rest and is typically unresponsive to all stimuli. SCP-8930 is avoidant to communication unless it is from Dr. Amber Roue herself.

SCP-8931 designates an anomalous compound found within all humans, colloquially referred to by Foundation staff as “the chemical of forgetting.” SCP-8931 bears token resemblance to Foundation-synthesized amnestics, but is exponentially more powerful, being able to completely remove memories of up to 2 hours in length with the production of only 3-4 milliliters.
SCP-8931 is capable of entirely removing data from the hippocampus with extreme precision and finality. Memories the compound affects ar

SCP-8932 refers to a bronze sculpture, 1.29 meters in height, depicting a great horned owl wearing a waistcoat, cravat, and pince-nez. The sculpture is connected to a concrete column in the Corinthian style, 2 meters in height, with a single inscription at the base reading "NO!"
SCP-8932 is located in Gadsden Square, a public park in the center of the village of Whitmore, Nebraska. Any human subject that comes within a 1.7-kilometer radius of SCP-8932 becomes an instance of SCP-8932-A. Leaving S
SCP-8933 is a topographical impossibility affecting Subbasement Level ▇▇ at Site-19.

SCP-8934 designates a small cloth doll approximately 27cm tall. Non-destructive testing has revealed that, in addition to cotton, the doll contains several human bones. The doll's head has many features resembling eyes.

SCP-8935 is the group designation for a hostile anomalous entity inhabiting the Tanny Mine near Woods Holler, West Virginia, USA, and the specific personnel affected by its cyclical period of ritualistic activity:

SCP-8936 is a minor god presiding over the concept of extinction. It takes the form of a small forage fish with a fire in its abdomen - a species it calls a "candlefish." The fire is visible thanks to the fish's thin, transparent scales, creating a unique form of bioluminescence that makes it hypervisible even in extremely dark environments or deep waters.


SCP-8936.


SCP-8936 can mimic any method of communication from any animal species, including humans. It is also capable of freeform flight
SCP-8937 is a cognitohazardous phenomenon transmitted by direct mutual eye contact with an instance of SCP-8937-1. Incidental or peripheral contact has not resulted in confirmed transmission.

SCP-8938 is a semi-sessile anthropophagic parasitoid, resembling a cross between a mollusc and an exotic form of anemone. Its central soft body is surrounded by layers of branching tendrils (see figure). It closely resembles a human cardiovascular system, but possesses a hidden beak/oviduct within the aortal chamber.
Any one instance of SCP-8938 has a lifespan of between 5 and 7 years after it has been implanted into the thoracic cavity. During this period, it slowly grows filamental structures

SCP-8940-Z “Zoya” and SCP-8940-L “Lorelei” are humanoid entities, capable of altering people’s moods and emotional state through music. The listener most often describes the experience as feeling the music “talking” to them, prompting an intimate understanding of what the music is trying to elicit from them.
Both SCP-8940-Z and -L do not possess a consistent physical appearance. General characteristics remain consistent, such as gender and age.
Characteristics that may change are as follows:

SCP-8941 is a herd of 30 mechanical constructs made to resemble sheep. All instances, each numbered from -1 to -30, can autonomously navigate the environment surrounding them regardless of their lack of electrical alimentation and sensory structures. All instances share an appearance consisting of a rotary phone replacing the head and a thick layer of swirled wire covering the body's outmost layer to then terminate in an electrical plug structure resembling a tail. Said elements differ in color,
Item 8942 was a human male approximately 190 cm in height and 57 kg in weight, who has been modified into a skinless invertebrate organism.

According to Earth's Roche limit, mainstream physics asserts that SCP-8943-M should have fractured immediately after its initial appearance, collapsing under Earth's gravity. Releasing 7.63 x 1010 terajoules of energy, the debris and heat would have ruptured Earth's mantle and evaporated the oceans, leading to an XK-Class End of World Scenario.


A satellite body is expected to disintegrate within the Roche limit of a larger celestial body.


SCP-8943 refers to the absence of the expected Roche

SCP-8944 is an eighteen-year-old Caucasian male of European descent, originally from Harlem, New York City, prior to its transfer to Site-78. It is a Class-I Type Green humanoid possessing reality bending abilities which it utilizes exclusively to pickpocket or engage in other forms of thievery. It appears unable to utilize its ontokinetic abilities or manipulate baseline reality to any degree when it is not actively doing so with the intention of bringing something into its possession. Due to a

SCP-8945 is the designation for the Prambanan temple compound, a 9th-century Hindu temple located in Bokoharjo, Special Region of Yogyakarta, Indonesia, approximately 17km from the city of Yogyakarta. SCP-8945’s effects manifest when artefacts and stone blocks compromising the temple are removed. Effects manifest slowly in individuals exposed to the artefacts over approximately 10 to 20 years after their removal, with symptoms resembling a traumatic brain injury (TBI). The known and documented e

SCP-8946 is the designation of a currently unknown spatial and temporal event that has resulted in the appearance of Geological Research Site-898, and the staff constituting it. These staff members claim to be of the Department of Geology, a Foundation department founded in the late 1950s, currently led by Director Hellen Gibbs. This information was found to be contradictory with files from Research and Containment Site-46 — which houses the Department of Geology and claims to have been founded
SCP-8947 is the group designation for any anomalous activity within the abandoned former Spirit Mountain Hotel and Casino near Laughlin, Nevada - specifically, its weekly cycle of anomalous activity.

data.descriptionExcerpt: SCP-8948是英國泰姆斯谷朗弗斯囊底路「霍爾沃德大道」上的房產。儘管存在可見的外部差異，且現有藍圖的建築特徵也有所不同，但SCP-8948所有實例在拓撲結構上均完全相同。

SCP-8949 is a memetic phenomenon in which sapient individuals are compelled to dig a hole at the nearest available location. Affected individuals typically will not engage in dangerous activities to satisfy this compulsion, but they have been recorded as traveling up to 400 km to find a suitable digging location. Every year, within one week of May 1st, SCP-9048-1 will manifest and draw in an audience to watch the upcoming performance. This occurrence has been designated as the "Ouroboros Event".

When the number of human teeth on Earth exceeds SCP-9049, no new teeth will develop; this affects the growth of deciduous and permanent teeth as well as all known anomalous dental sources. The gravestone of PoI-9052-1 will henceforth be referred to as SCP-9052-1. All anomalous activity at SCP-9052-1 took place over the time period of 1/22/201█ to 1/29/201█, periodically from 11:00 PM - 11:59 PM every day.

SCP-9053 designates an anomalous phenomenon affecting mannequins, dolls, and other imitations of humanity. These mannequins will often be observed engaging in behavior that suggests sapience and locomotion, often in a manner that is considered uncanny and threatening. All observed events have later been determined to have entirely mundane explanations, however the frequency at which these events occur still warrant investigation.

SCP-9054 is an extradimensional anomaly located in New York City, New York. Before its sudden collapse, SCP-9054 was an infinitely large industrial complex with non-Euclidean2 internal geometry. SCP-9054 was previously only accessible via an access tunnel in the city's subway system, and only in the presence of SCP-9054-1, henceforth referred to as Sr. Researcher Nicholas Feynman.
Due to his unique interaction with SCP-9054, Feynman was assigned as the team lead for the project. It quickly becam
SCP-9055 is a large, complex, subterranean structure located directly below Site-14.

SCP-9056 is an amorphous mass fluctuating between 1 and 2 meters in height which levitates approximately 1.5 meters off the ground at all times. Its surface constantly displays an ever-changing array of images, the meaning of which is currently unknown. The object is sentient and capable of telepathic communication within a range of 5 meters.

SCP-9057 is a phenomenon that interferes in the perception of an individual's speech. It does not have an effect on non-verbal methods of communication. Anyone hearing this altered speech will perceive it as uninteresting in both content and delivery. Due to this perception being subjective, different individuals will perceive this speech in different ways. Individuals afflicted with SCP-9057 are not affected in this way, but suffer from other effects, including:

persistent, mild forgetfulness.

SCP-9058 is an adult male domestic cat; it weighs 4.9kg, has black fur, and is neutered. While SCP-9058 is apparently healthy and genetically and anatomically normal, it has not been observed to vocalize at all.
SCP-9059 is an event involving two human subjects, designated SCP-9059-FINDER and SCP-9059-SEEKER.

SCP-9060 refers to a viral cognitohazardous phenomenon that causes a person (designated SCP-9060-1) to enter a violent state when their full face is viewed by another human (designated SCP-9060-2), whether directly, via video recording, photography, or on social media platforms.

SCP-9061 was a Charlie I class nuclear submarine, manufactured by the USSR at some point between 1967 and 1969. SCP-9061's hull was completely black, lacking any of the typical markings found on other vessels of the same class. SCP-9061 was capable of autonomous movement, as well as travelling at speeds and depths far greater than what its structure should have been capable of.
SCP-9061 would typically keep to depths between 800m and 1000m, making tracking difficult. However, it would occasional

SCP-9062 is a cube-like structure, hypothesised to exist in a higher dimensional plane than our own. Its standard size is 9 x 9 x 9 metres, though has been observed to shrink to as small as 2 x 2 x 2 millimetres, and expand as large as 30 x 30 x 30 metres. There is no known upper or lower limits to how much it can alter its size.

SCP-9063 is a series of abnormal fatalities occurring in and around the unincorporated community of Pemberton, Texas. As of Foundation recording, no cause for these fatalities has been established, nor have the conditions for such an anomaly to occur been identified. As of writing, the last SCP-9063 incident occurred on October 20, 2024.

The organism's exterior is similar in texture and appearance to a standard cotton/polyester material. The interior of the pants is similarly non-anomalous in appearance, and it is currently unknown how the organism keeps its teeth concealed when not feeding. SCP-9066 is not a physical object, entity, location, or phenomenon, it exists only as an intrinsic and universal human experience. It is always described as a nude, hairless, featureless, androgynous humanoid of average stature. Proper and unambiguous explanation of SCP-9066 to non-human life proved impossible. SCP-9067 is capable of targeting individuals based on a psychospheric signature consisting of 3 or more semantic markers. The current iteration has been modified for use in Foundation-manufactured SKYEYE, EVILEYE and BIG SKY series drones.

Considered naturally occurring within the noosphere, these "wildfires" function to destroy and erase the debris that's been gathering dust in our collective heads. SCP-9068 is theorized to function akin to how baseline wildfires affect forests via fire ecology: when half-formed or fading concepts begin to build up within the noosphere and amalgam, these gatherings are marked as "dry," "cracked," "flammable." It expanded to an estimated radius of 200,000 to 350,000 kilometers from its point of origin and passed through most materials without resistance. When static, these engravings resemble 15th century Arabic calligraphy, although the characters do not correspond to any known extinct or modern language. The teapot is worn, and has several cracks around its rim which prevents a lid from being placed on it.

Members of SCP-9119 display atypical behavior where various processes of the colony are used in unproductive or actively detrimental ways. This includes the creation of unnecessary rooms within the colony, the storage of small amounts of food, eggs, and detritus within those rooms, and hyper-aggression toward ants not part of SCP-9119.

How SCP-9122 accessed the channel is currently unknown. SCP-9122 is extrasolar1 in origin, with its exact broadcast location unknown. The transmission itself consists of dialogue in an unintelligible alien language lasting exactly four minutes and thirty-two seconds in length. data.descriptionExcerpt: SCP-9124 是一種共享疾病，血液可以在患者之間交換。已知有七名女性受影響，其中四名的身份已被確認。儘管患者之間無物理接觸，注射入其中一名患者體內的物質會於數分鐘至數週不等的時間內出現在其他患者的血液內，而每位患者的心跳可以在其他人體內隱約地被探測到。新的患者可以透過已知患者血液中的DNA來確認身份。
SCP-9125 is the root of human unreason.
SCP-9126 is an anomalous subspecies of the ichneumon wasp Podogaster Cactorum. SCP-9126 instances appear identical to their non-anomalous counterparts, and behave mostly identically as well.

SCP-9127 is a 75 cm long bansuri2 made out of a single long shaft of bamboo, featuring six holes for playing. The embouchure is made of ivory and has been tied with a thin thread to prevent cracking. SCP-9127 is adorned with jewels, which display no anomalous effects. SCP-9128 is a book titled the book of all things by dado. Despite its size, SCP-9128 has an infinite number of pages. SCP-9128 is a dictionary containing all possible combinations of letters and their definitions.

SCP-9129 is an abnormally large humanoid skeleton discovered in the Sakai Scrub Natural Area. It is interred upright, with its upper half exposed. Before containment, the remains were overgrown with crossvine. The ribcage has been distended by a massive, empty wasp's nest. Layered white stains under the orbital and nasal cavities are attributed to bird feces. The bones remain connected in the absence of ligaments. The flesh has entirely decayed.
Approaching SCP-9129 with the intent to touch it r

SCP-9130 is an effect that transforms members of the Coniferous and Deciduous2 groups of trees into SCP-9130-1 instances. 9130-1 instances have an increased metabolism and growth rate, which appear at first to be ectoentropic in nature, but actually drains from the surrounding reality for nutrition. SCP-9130-1 instances measurably have a lower Hume reading than baseline, indicating that they are acting as a constant reality sink. It is currently unknown how SCP-9130-1 instances convert reality t

SCP-9131 is the collective designation for an unknown number of objects possessing enclosed spaces. Extensive testing has revealed that the material composition of SCP-9131 instances can only be altered from matter inside the instance.

SCP-9132 is a small hardbound book of an indeterminate number of pages. No title or similarly recognizable clues to signify an author or origin are present with its cover otherwise depicting an encircled hexagram through iron rivets. The leather used in SCP-9132's binding is composed from several disparate animal sources, including Bos taurus, Equus ferus caballus, Capra hircus, Homo sapiens, and Panthera leo1. SCP-9133 is a beach ball, possessing a low density. Despite this, the object is negatively buoyant.

data.descriptionExcerpt: SCP-9135 is a highly organized cloud with a rain-free base, wall cloud, and anvil top. It should be noted that SCP-9135 is currently intensifying into a supercell thunderstorm.

SCP-9136 is a wheelchair that is able to move autonomously, requiring no maintenance, and which can manifest small quantities of alcohol, cigarettes, or other illicit substances in its folds and pockets. It has a high degree of situational awareness regarding its surroundings and immediate context, using that information to navigate itself towards individuals using mobility devices.

SCP-9137 proper refers to a river that suddenly appeared within the ████████ region of ██████2. The appearance of the river has led to water from the anomalous zone contaminating the groundwater in use by the nearby town of ██████3.

SCP-9138 is the newly dominant moral framework of the universe as of 25/06/1950. It selects sapient souls considered exceptional by their peers, distinguishing them primarily by their tomb decorations and grave-goods. Souls so recognised by their community are sorted into a variety of paradisiacal afterlives which reflect their actions while living. These afterlives embody SCP-9138-A’s ethical and aesthetic values, and are structured to reward and further perpetuate such behaviour.

SCP-9139 is Foundation Team Lead Malkinder Singh Chattha, age 26, who experiences a constant state of disequilibrium unaffected by medications and therapy. Extensive imagery, both anomalous and nonanomalous, has displayed no expected internal physiological explanation. Instead, SCP-9139 exerts an uncontrollable, mild reality-bending effect on itself that perpetually affects its sense of balance.

SCP-9140 is a set of Daevite ritual objects, referred to in translated primary sources as the Imperial Bloodsieve. Its principal component (designated SCP-9140-1) is a carved stone statue, measuring 12.5cm in height. The statue resembles the figure of a pregnant woman, with glyphs carved around its circumference. Above the carvings, there is a groove carved into the stone, measuring 0.7cm in width and 0.5cm in depth.







An artistic representation of SCP-9140.

SCP-9141 is an umbrella term referring to all minor curses placed onto the Foundation. There are currently 37 active curses and 8957 in the history of SCP-9141’s written record.2

SCP-9142 is a collective designation for a colony of four sapient rodents capable of producing an HUME-Degradation pheromone.1 This anomalous pheromone only manifests following the consumption of Mentha cunninghamii2 leaves. SCP-9142 will produce their HUME-Degradation pheromone for approximately two hours following activation, after which no anomalous traits can be observed. SCP-9143, also known as Lake Love, is a lake in Tennessee measured to be 6400m², located in the south-eastern region of the rural mining town "██████."

SCP-9144 is a chemically unidentified viscous liquid with similar properties to oil. It generally appears red in colour. The item's main anomalous property is the capability to smooth human skin to anomalous extents with contact.1 This effect is progressive with contact, and It is unknown if there is a limit to which the fluids properties will scale to, for more information see Test Log A3/9144, attached below in this document.

The properties of SCP-9145 only take effect when it is utilized by a subject between the ages of 4 and 11 years old. Drawings made using SCP-9145 will typically manifest as entities designated SCP-9145-A.

No sovereign nation, administrative territory, or historical polity by this name has been identified in any known record.

SCP-9147 is a species of humanoids that appear indistinguishable from humans. All examined instances of SCP-9147 exhibit specialized digestive tracts and are incapable of ingesting anything other than human flesh. Any deviations in diet have resulted in severe nausea, vomiting, and involuntary muscle spasms.

SCP-9148 is a prototype paraweapon developed in the 1970s by the Soviet Union's Main Intelligence Directorate, Psychotronics Division (GRU-P) for use in assassinations. The device superficially resembles a pistol, but kills through the use of psychokinetic force, rather than projectiles.

SCP-9149 is a virus of unknown composition, the structure of which appears snowflake-shaped when viewed under a microscope. Subjects infected with SCP-9149 become obsessed with celebrating the Christmas holiday and will alter their behavior and routines to center completely around activities associated with Christmas, even if they do not celebrate the holiday or possess Christian beliefs.

SCP-9150 refers to an anomaly that is present in the mind of every living Homo sapiens.

SCP-9151-A is an orange tree that grows half oranges instead of full oranges. Every instance of the fruit, henceforth referred to as SCP-9151-B, possesses an anomalous property that moves it autonomously, pushing it to combine with another SCP-9151-B instance from the same crop. This process is known as SCP-9151-C and it lasts anywhere from a second to an hour. Afterwards, the two SCP-9151-B instances become indistinguishable from a non-anomalous orange.

For unknown reasons, the entity is only able to manifest on Earth once per year on September 24th. Manifestations are typically fairly brief, with the longest recorded manifestation lasting for 7 minutes. When a pair of SCP-9161 are worn, a neurological link between the shoes and the wearer is formed so that any damage to the shoe manifests as a temporary lesion of the brain at a topographically corresponding site. SCP-9165 is a tall, humanoid entity approximately 1.9 meters tall, referred to as "Indrid Cold." The entity is dressed formally, wearing a suit or coat and pants made of the same unknown material. The entity is known to teleport and appear in multiple locations at once. SCP-9165 is described by exposed personnel to be visually intimidating even when viewed from a distance. SCP-9165 is known to communicate through telepathy.

The other 34 houses on Gorse Avenue are similar in style and further details have been omitted from this report due to their non-anomalous nature. The anomaly affects children who enter Westwood Grove Playschool permanently, and no effective cure has been found as of writing.

SCP-9173 measures 3.5 meters tall, with a pedestal measuring 0.6 meters on each side. To date, all attempts to damage SCP-9173 for the purpose of collecting samples have failed, presumably due to the influence of SCP-9173-A.

Unmagnified photographs and witness accounts of the phenomenon describe an exceptionally bright, abnormally slow meteor, which originated over Andromeda and proceeded south, crossing the entire night sky until it passed the horizon. Kowalska during a survey expedition for an unrelated investigation. His handwritten notes and drawings of the property were found to be unaffected by its paranormal effect. Foundation spatial penetration technology is able to override this if required. The illness can be first detected mere minutes after infection, however, it only takes full effect around 24 hours following initial exposure. SCP-9198 refers to a hostile, hivemind-like organism that visually mimics the appearance of snow. Its diet primarily consists of siphoning any nearby sources of thermal energy and organic matter, which it utilizes to replicate on a massive scale. Despite its potential to trigger an NK-Class (“Grey Goo”) Scenario, SCP-9198 is currently contained within the confines of Montreal Island in Canada, effectively preventing a global catastrophe.
A direct consequence of SCP-9198’s sustained presence on t

data.titleJP: And to Think That I Saw It on Mulberry Street
data.descriptionExcerpt: URA-7DL is a bipedal chimerical entity, origin unknown, estimated to be two meters in height. It is composed of bodily features from a ram, tortoise, baboon, crab, scorpion, ox, and snakes. URA-7DL is capable of emitting sarin gas, and has been reported to flay and devour children, using their skin as clothing. Prior to Foundation discovery, it had been sighted seven kilometers southwest of ████████, but its current whereabouts are unknown.
SCP-9200是一台已墜毀的太空旅行5載具，位於希臘馬克羅尼索斯島。SCP-9200現行的人工智慧（以下稱SCP-9200-A）現仍維持運作，在飛船於至少三千年前墜毀島上開始已持續運作至今。該載具在船體及主要系統已承受災難性的損毀。該載具仍有移動能力，並已遁入中央島嶼的山脊之中。6SCP基金會透過與希臘政府達成協議，對受影響區域維持有限度的控制能力。

SCP-9201 is the Foundation Reality Transaction Manager (FRTM), a piece of paratechnology which enables ACID transaction processing on a piece of local reality. Due to its immense power requirements and the difficulty of properly determining conceptual parameters, effective use for Foundation operations is challenging.
The primary use of the FRTM is in SCP-9201-A, the Foundation Field Anomaly Analyzer (FFAA). This 47 kilogram device interfaces with an internally-installed limited-use SCP-9201 ins

SCP-9202 is a worldwide network, thaumaturgic in nature, that allows for parsing and transmission of emotion and subconscious intent at a higher rate than would be normally possible. SCP-9202 is responsible for the level of advanced reasoning and coordination required for modern civilization. SCP-9202 originates from thaumochemical reactions inside of the human brain.
Discovered in Whistlebay, Wyoming in 1992 following a number of sightings and reports of kidnappings by the entity. Moved to Site-19 following negotiations.

SCP-9204 is a male Golden Retriever dog colloquially referred to as Milo. When given a verbal command to "fetch," SCP-9204 will always retrieve an object. This retrieval is uninhibited by distance, size, and other factors that would normally limit feasibility. A minority of requests result in retrieval of an object other than the one requested. The significance of non-target objects retrieved is unknown.

SCP-9205 is a cylindrical jar made of polished black marble, 14 cm in height and 10 cm in diameter, undecorated except for the Latin words carved into the lid: Male parta male dilabuntur.1 The jar is capable of self-repair, having survived multiple gunshots during attempts to acquire it, and it is not known if it can be permanently damaged or destroyed.
The contents of the jar consist of an opaque grey gel, which cannot be completely extracted or exhausted, as SCP-9205 automatically generates mo
SCP-9206 is a spontaneous phenomenon biannually affecting 67% of England's adult Avifauna.
SCP-9207 refers to a genetically and thaumaturgically modified subspecies of the common pill-bug (Armadillidium vulgare promethei). SCP-9207 are fully sapient and communicate telepathically.

SCP-9208-A is a sentient manifestation of the concept of Autophobia1. SCP-9208-A's exact appearance is difficult to document; however it has been consistently described as a feminine humanoid. SCP-9208-A most commonly manifests in crowded areas, especially areas designated as battlefields. SCP-9208-A was first discovered during the beginning of what is now known the ΔK-Class ("Stop Making Sense") scenario.
While in the presence of any being with sapience, SCP-9208-A will begin to excrete a cogni

SCP-9209 is a caucasian male of approximately 14 years of age, standing 1.45 meters in height, with pale skin and shoulder-length dirty blonde hair. It is fully verbal, with fluency in French, Latin, and English. It has demonstrated basic levels of education as well as an acute awareness of historical events across multiple centuries. Two (2) large white feathered wings extend from its upper back, though it has not been observed utilizing them for flight. SCP-9209 was recovered wearing clothing

SCP-9210 are anomalous zones in the continental United States mapping to enrollment boundaries1 of public elementary schools that enroll over 10 times the number of students as the next most populated.

SCP-9211 are small insectoids similar in size and shape to the Musca domestica (housefly); their entire physiology comprises parts of timepieces which move and operate similarly to the timepiece they represent. Each unique SCP-9211 instance is composed of random parts that operational instances use to construct new ones.


An instance of SCP-9211-D


There are nine known variations of SCP-9211, all of which utilise machinery similar to various timekeeping mechanisms. Below is a chart detailing t
SCP-9212-D was an anomalous humanoid resembling a middle aged Native American male. It was a thaumaturgist capable of teleportation, transfiguration, and spontaneous energy manifestation.

SCP-9213 refers to an abnormally large female specimen of Ursus Arctos, commonly known as a grizzly bear. While most specimens measure out to be two meters long and one meter tall, SCP-9213 measures approximately one-hundred lightyears long and thirty-five lightyears tall, although exact measurements are beyond current capabilities. While several factors should have led to the subject’s demise, such as difficulty to take in oxygen at its current size and a lack of oxygen, SCP-9213 appears to be

SCP-9214 is the designation for a collection of mind affecting, sapient hexapodal entities. Adult instances are approximately 3 meters in length, while the size of juveniles is dependent on the human host used for incubation.

SCP-9215 is the Applewood Public Library, located in Applewood, New Mexico, United States. It consists of six stories and covers an area of 200,000 square feet. A number of anomalous phenomena have been incorporated into the library's operations; these phenomena are under the complete control of the library's chief librarian, and can be modified or suspended at their command. See Addendum 9215-2 for more information.
SCP-9215 is inhabited by 15 14 anomalous entities, designated SCP-9215-A-1 thro

SCP-9216 is a sapient organic biomass. The individual tissues and cells that make up SCP-9216 resemble those of a human, and it often maintains a nearly human figure. Its actual anatomy is highly fluid, such that its organs, their number, and their relative placement around its body are highly variable; it is not uncommon for fully-formed facial features to emerge from the dermal layers of SCP-9216 over the course of several minutes, move across the surface of its skin, and then disappear in a s

SCP-9218 is the nexus known as FP-32, better known as "Adjacent-Oslo," a Free Port designated nexus that is currently under the covert administration of The SCP Foundation, and consists of a network of subway stations and tunnels connected to each other, located in an extradimensional space anchored to Oslo, Norway.
see Addendum 1
SCP-9220 is a condition affecting approximately 0.00001%2 of humans bearing maternal organs. SCP-9220 manifests as spontaneous pregnancy, in many cases without any prior evidence of conception.

SCP-9221 designates 187 traffic cones, varying in size, color, and design. When arranged2 the instances connect to form an invisible barrier. With the exception of motor vehicles, the barrier remains permeable to all forms of matter.

SCP-9222 is Alice Starr, a non-anomalous human being related through unknown means to SCP-9222-1, an anomalous event/killing that occurred on June 4th, 1929. The victim, an as yet unidentified woman, was found brutalized in the Bayou Sauvage National Wildlife Refuge in New Orleans. Her eyes were noted to be heavily damaged, though other traumas were additionally present. The primary suspect is a Mr. Adam Altair, director of the local 'Rising Sun' opera house. Altair reported the body within 2 ho

SCP-9223 is a ritual that was carried out on the date of the Wesak festival1 at seven locations in 595 CE, during the reign of Emperor Wen of Sui (隋文帝). The instructions for the ritual were diligently recorded by at least 18 monastic communities with continuity to the current day, and can thus be reconstructed confidently. The following is a description of the ritual from the Daxingshan archives, which is typical of these records:


First, using powder of lead and the ash created by burning a wr

Recovered following a civilian incident in West Hollywood, California. The entity was reported as "emerging from the ground" and targeted four Canadian tourists. There were 26 casualties and 49 instances of gross rectal damage during transportation to Site Victorville. (See File SCP-9224-194B.)
Item SCP-9224 is a bilaterally symmetrical, needle-shaped organism, 9.5 feet tall and roughly 8 inches at its widest point. Both ends taper to points with an estimated tip radius below 0.3 millimeters. Co

SCP-9225 is an island located in the Mediterranean sea, between Greece and Libya, measuring 80km in radius with an area of 20,000km2. The island is cloaked by an antimemetic effect, and as such, is entirely imperceptible and inaccessible to individuals not under the effects of mnestic drugs. The island itself has its topography partially warped in various locations, but most notably in the shoreline and its center. This can manifest via the bending of rocks to form sharp and uneven edges, as wel

A mature SCP-9226 specimen


SCP-9226 is a species of flowering plant belonging to a monotypical genus in the family Asteraceae.1 It grows as a herbaceous vine-like shrub measuring approximately 50 cm (20 in) in height at full maturity. It produces inflorescent amber-fuchsia flowers which it uses to attract its primary pollinator, Eurycotis floridana.2
The seeds of SCP-9226 are normally inedible and toxic due to high concentrations of non-anomalous toxins which may be neutralized through boiling

SCP-9227 is a piece of copy paper with a drawing of a fictional country labeled "The United Federation Republic of New Pacifical States" on top of the paper. According to the drawing, the country is supposedly located in the Pacific Ocean, between North America and Asia. On the bottom right is a compass with a human eye in the center. The country contains 26 states, consisting of:

Alford
Temsfork
Columbia Fields
Heights of Dale
Wilshore
Crution
Denton
Pacificana
Omveron

Mellburg
SCP-9228 is a 19-year-old human female. All humans within a 3.11-kilometre range of it will receive an anomalous healing effect.
SCP-9229 is a construct of unknown origin occupying approx. 70% of the volume of Saturn's satellite Iapetus. Preliminary gravity gradiometer data indicate a layered structure.

SCP-9230 refers to a lake in western Bulgaria. Temporal displacement in the location around the anomaly causes the immediate area to maintain a consistent state of what would constitute midnight anywhere else.

SCP-9231 was the designation given to now defunct phenomena wherein memetically-augmented sestinas1 were anomalously imbued with the essence of a particular concept. The imbued concept, designated as SCP-9231-A, would always appear as one of the repeating words within the sestina. When was interpreted in either written or spoken form, the essence of the instance's SCP-9231-A would reflect upon the interpreter, causing them to manifest properties associated with the concept for a period of time.2

SCP-9232 is a humanoid male standing roughly 1.85 meters in height. The subject exhibits extensive thermal damage across the majority of its body surface, with an absence of body hair except for the scalp. The entity's clothing remains intact but charred and appears to be heat resistant.

Facial tissue has undergone significant thermal deformation, resulting in a fixed expression resembling a smile due to fusion and contraction of surrounding musculature and dermal layers.

發現情況不明──項目自有記錄以降始終儲存於Site-19。項目是一種生物實體，組成與起源均來自外星。報告描述其表皮呈灰色半透明狀。SCP-9233只能受到一次觀察。一旦初始視線中斷，項目將變得無法觀察且無形。視覺與聽覺記錄均為如此。

SCP-9234 is the designation given to an anomalous effect that, until recently, affected all food consumed within the boundaries of ████‎█‎‎█, Virginia. Any edible item ingested inside the town retained its normal physical properties, including but not limited to:

appearance
taste
texture
nutritional content
chemical composition

However, the item would be somehow be extraphysically transubstantiated into human flesh. Standard scientific analysis could detect no difference from ordinary food.
SCP-9236 is the city which will be built between the Tigris and Euphrates in June of 2043, and the process of its habitation.
SCP-9237 is a standard 35 lb4 tape measure. It has no branding nor serial number leaving SCP-9237's manufacturer unknown.

SCP-9238 is a human embryo at approximately 8 weeks' gestational equivalent2, measuring roughly 1.6 cm in length. It has shown no measurable developmental progression beyond this stage since initial containment. Aside from its developmental arrest, the subject exhibits no physiological abnormalities and remains biologically stable within its current containment environment.
Genetic analysis has failed to identify SCP-9238's biological parents, and its genome does not correspond to any known indi

SCP-9239 is an extradimensional space created through ontokinetic manipulation. It takes the form of a realm consisting of creatures and objects similar to those depicted in common fairy tales. The entrance to this realm is currently located in the area formerly designated as Containment Unit 428-B,1 which has replaced the steel doors with a door of a design typically seen in medieval fortresses. Entering through this door will lead to a dense forest with trees as tall as 60 meters, and mythical

SCP-9241 is a 1952 Australian penny of moderate wear with a diameter of 30.8 mm. The coin has basic predatory intelligence and is keenly aware of its surroundings despite an observed lack of sensory organs.

SCP-9242 is a spatiotemporal anomaly that manifests as a hiking trail extending approximately 7,769 kilometers, beginning within the Priazovsky State Nature Preserve in Russia, and presumed to end at a point in north-central Mongolia, approximately 3 kilometers south-southwest of Erdenet. While SCP-9242 exists outside consensus reality, its geography corresponds to that of the baseline regions it traverses, allowing SCP-9242 to be mapped using data collected during testing. Furthermore, GPS trac

SCP-9244 is Lake Harrison, an artificial retention pond located near Harrow, Nevada, United States. Despite being artificially created and lacking any record or evidence of wildlife, fishing equipment utilized in SCP-9244 will often successfully result in catches at a rate similar to natural lakes of its size. Fish caught in SCP-9244, designated SCP-9244-A, are universally freshwater fish native to Nevada, though often are members of species not native to the specific region in which SCP-9244 is

SCP-9245 is a residential building in a gated community in upstate New York, built in 1995. Every room has three or more access ports that open to a network of small freight elevators spanning the building. While these are similar in design to modern dumbwaiters, a robust system of pulleys allows them to move in three dimensions along provided rails.
SCP-9245's dumbwaiter network connects to a 0.5 m x 0.5 m shaft in the basement, designated SCP-9245-A. SCP-9245-A is filled primarily with the mec

SCP-9246 is an annual phenomenon that occurs on January 10 every year, centralized to a remote location of the Shirakami Mountains in Japan’s Akita Prefecture. During this time, local reality in the area will become unstable, with rapidly and wildly fluctuating Hume levels recorded by Foundation sensors. The phenomenon will last approximately 24 hours, with an initial spike in fluctuations occurring around 7:30am local time and a final spike happening 24 hours later, after which all effects will

SCP-9247 is a class-4 ontokineticist named Juniper Castel, the daughter of Timothy Castel and Janine Springer. She is currently 14 years old. SCP-9247 entered Foundation custody after a rampancy event which occurred several months after the emergence of her anomalous capabilities. Her passive influence on the hume field measures in the top 10th percentile among class-4 ontokineticists, making her the third most ontokinetically potent humanoid currently contained by the Foundation.
The products o
SCP-9248 is a male human cadaver, 31 years of age at the time of death. Objects brought within the vicinity of SCP-9248 are occasionally replaced with other objects.

Brought to Foundation's attention and successfully contained in 1958; however, historical documents indicate its existence long before. SCP-9249 is a series of motile stone monoliths bound to a meadow near Ypres, Belgium. Each instance is engraved with a face, typified by elongated, warped features—sometimes pitched at odd angles or with multiple lineaments layered atop one another. Each stone stands at around 2 meters tall.1 The number of SCP-9249 instances is dynamic and changes on a regular b

data.descriptionExcerpt: SCP-9250 is a musical composition, arranged and created by Dr. X. Flip, current Director of Site-109. The piece itself is orchestral in nature, and has been performed several separate times to great emotional effect in each of its subjects.

SCP-9251 is a male, domestic shorthair cat (Felis catus) with an orange, mackerel tabby coat. SCP-9251 is otherwise non-anomalous, with vital signs, nutritional requirements, and general biological functions falling within the expected range for a creature of its species.
The anomalous properties of SCP-9251 manifest as a 3.00-second temporal desynchronization between its visual/auditory manifestation and its physical mass. SCP-9251's visual and auditory presence exists exactly 3.00 seconds ahea

SCP-9253 is a state of psychosis and amnesia that is incurable. There is no apparent natural cause to this state. It is characterised by heightened pressure, which is believed to be causing the psychosis. At the time of writing, one individual is known to be affected by SCP-9253, designated SCP-9253-1. SCP-9253-1 believes it is a knight in medieval times, with no familiarity with modern inventions. The personality appears to be based on modern interpretations of the time period. SCP-9253-1's pre

SCP-9254 is a behavioral phenomenon associated with the Adélie penguin (Pygoscelis adeliae), a species of penguin common to the coasts of Antarctica. Specimens affected by SCP-9254 are henceforth referred to as SCP-9254-1.
Thorough observation and testing have concluded that SCP-9254 is an idiopathic, rather than a causal or probabilistic, phenomenon in nature, and, to this date, no cause has been identified for the instantiation of SCP-9254 among Adélie penguin specimens. However, in all observ

SCP-9255 is a space within Site-17 that does not exist, accessible via an antimemetic unlocked door on level 9, corridor 3-F. It admits only one individual at a time, becoming sealed from the outside while it is occupied. SCP-9255's interior dimensions and structure are variable, changing for each occupant. In the event that an individual enters SCP-9255, the previous occupant will forget what they experienced while inside the anomaly.

SCP-9256 is an anomalous computer virus which spreads through electronic mail and advertisements on Internet message boards. These messages will typically use the phrases "Cumputer Playmate" or "More than just a dial up <3!" in reference to SCP-9256. These messages appear to be generated by the virus.

This an example of an advertisement for SCP-9256, found on Parawatch.net. This advertisement has been left unedited except for the removal of the download link for SCP-9256.

SCP-9257, along with two non-anomalous plates of nachos, were ordered as appetizers for the Site-99 Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team's end-of-quarter celebration. About 20 minutes after SCP-9257 was consumed, three of the four personnel who shared it realized that they had abruptly become homosexual. The subjects who ate SCP-925

SCP-9259 is a phenomenon regarding every known Scientologist-affiliated building. If an individual enters the building without express permission from members of the Church, the building's layout will shift in an attempt to keep them from entering the central room. These attempts are largely nonviolent on the first activation of SCP-9259. MTF Xunu-1 has noted increased levels of aggression as activations of SCP-9259 continue.
Entering the central room of the building will always lead to the disc

SCP-9260 is the spontaneous imprinting on toilet paper rolls with the image of patent US390084A (fig. 1). The image is present in every sheet of each roll affected (collectively designated SCP-9260-1).

SCP-9264 designates an anomalous phenomenon affecting Earth’s rotational cycle, whose activity is judged based on the diurnal cycle observed around Mount Chimborazo’s equatorial region.2While the Chimborazo area experiences daylight3, the planet’s overall rotational velocity decreases at a consistent, regular rate. Conversely, rotational speed rises uniformly during nighttime hours within the same region4.

SCP-9265 is a children’s book titled “What’s a poem?”, the cover of which is included above.

The effects of this anomaly are not what dreams are made of.

The object possesses a cognitohazard that forces subjects who have read the book to speak in rhyme.

Testing is ongoing to determine for how much time.

This effect also occurs with those trying to write or talk about the book.

This happens regardless of whether the subject has opened the object and taken a look.

SCP-9266 is Julia Quartz, an anomalous human female, age 30 at the time of containment. SCP-9266 has leafless, dark-green, vine-like growths on its body, from here on out referred to as SCP-9266-1. SCP-9266-1 and its flowers do not correspond to any known plant, anomalous or otherwise. How these came to grown on SCP-9266 is currently unknown.
SCP-9266 does not eat more than a baseline human but does consume more water. SCP-9266-1 instances undergo photosynthesis and produce small amounts of oxyg

SCP-9267 is a fatal neurodegenerative memetic disease that is transmitted through social media platforms. Instances of those affected by SCP-9267 are designated SCP-9267-1. The symptoms of SCP-9267 begin within days of contraction, starting mild before rapidly increasing in lethality:
SCP-9268 is consistently described by individuals affected by SCP-9268 as the skull of an Odocoileus virginianus.1

SCP-9269 is a humanoid entity acting as the physical vessel for two sapient ontological anomalies, designated SCP-9269-A and SCP-9269-B. The physical body resembles an adult male standing 2.14 meters in height. The subject wears an unremovable suit of armor composed of an unidentified dense alloy. Microscopic analysis of the left pauldron revealed a faded serial number ("MK-IV-992A"). A persistent low-frequency hum (approx. 40 Hz) emits from the armour regardless of the active persona.
