SCP-9270 is an eigenweapon developed by the Foundation, measuring approximately 2.4m x 1.8m x 1.6m, composed of interlocking metallic components, analog input interfaces, and organic material interlaced throughout its internal chassis. SCP-9270 is continuously operational, despite the lack of a power source.

Found in Colorado Springs post office in 1995, later requisitioned as ALBION DEFILADE. Entryway does not maintain stable configuration; initial discovery noted cordite residues and two spent .45 ACP shells in the area, alongside a carelessly folded postal worker's uniform. The threshold has taken forms including (but not limited to) a trapdoor, a chimney, a garden path, an airport terminal, and a dentist’s chair.

SCP-9274 is a series of adpositions3 originating from an extinct language isolate sharing similarities to many ancient Celtic languages, although this is believed to be due to aerial influence. Instances are capable of "slotting into" any human language, functioning as prefixes, suffixes, infixes, or standalone words, according to the chosen language's sentence syntax. However, they do not conform to said languages' phonotactics4 or phonological inventories5. However, SCP-9274 instances do not f
SCP-9275 is a set of anomalous events occurring within the Philippines. Such phenomena occur at varying times and locations, but the following information has been consistent with each occurrence:
SCP-9277 is a 74-year old human female named Esther Gallagher, capable of passive reality bending.

SCP-9278 is the current entity responsible for transportation of souls between the physical world and the afterlife. It manifests as a human female of European descent, appearing to be 8-10 years of age. It is always seen wearing a caped black cloak and carrying a scythe. Despite said items being significantly oversized for SCP-9278's height, they do not seem to cause the anomaly any physical discomfort.
Upon a given organism's expiration, SCP-9278 will manifest and separate the specimen’s soul

SCP-9280 is an underground gladiatorial arena located near Krasnoyarsk, Siberia, three miles north of Site-191. Foundation archeologists have concluded that the arena was built in approximately 320 BCE while the territory was controlled by the Daevite Empire.
SCP-9280 is believed to have been in active use from the time of its completion up until the conquest of the area by the Adytite Empire around 20 BCE. When and how SCP-9280 acquired its anomalous properties is unknown.
SCP-9280’s main arena

SCP-9281 is a humanoid entity with a limited shapeshifting ability. The entity has the ability to mimic others, including both mental and physical attributes. SCP-9281 does not produce a perfect copy of the original subject and differences will occur in both physical appearance and behaviour.
Minor differences displayed by SCP-9281 will be focused around areas of the body the copied subject felt insecure about, countering the reason for the insecurity. SCP-9281’s copy of knowledge and memory sur

SCP-9282 refers to a large box of adhesive fabric bandages. Upon discovery, the box contained 72 out of 110 listed items. Due to testing, only 66 currently remain. If placed upon an open wound, SCP-9282 instances will act as a non-anomalous standard bandage. SCP-9282’s anomalous properties manifest upon placing an instance on a disfigured or amputated limb, or an approximate location of a removed or altered organ.
Testing has revealed that SCP-9282 is capable of fully regenerating limbs or organ

SCP-9285 is a pair of objects, designated SCP-9285-1 and SCP-9285-2 respectively. SCP-9285-1 is an old Steinway & Sons grand piano, presumed to have been built in the mid 1930s. Despite how old the piano is, no visible wear is found on the piano, internally or externally. SCP-9285-1, when played, will sound perfect to those listening, and has never needed retuned. People who have heard SCP-9285-1 played have described it as "the most beautiful, soulful piano you'll ever hear." SCP-9285-2 is a ge
Large, sapient organism of indeterminate origin, discovered in March 1986 on a family-owned pastoral farm near Dodge City, Kansas, United States.

SCP-9288 refers to the second door from the right on the first floor corridor of the Holloway Estate at 51██ █████████ Drive in Houston Texas, as well as the space behind it and the connected subrealities (SCP-9288-1 and -2 respectively).

SCP-9290 is a 93.72 KB executable file titled "dadotool.exe". When opened, SCP-9290 will create a 900x450 window titled "remove from internet tool by dado", featuring a background of colourful stars and text reading "remove form internet tool by dado 1.03"1 The window contains text boxes for an IP address and Port and a button reading "remove from internet".
When a valid IP address and Port are entered into the text boxes and the button is pressed, the target device will be destroyed in a direct

SCP-9291 describes a small, cardboard box of bandages. Although there is no notable branding on the exterior, the phrase "Bravery Badges" can be seen on the front of the box. When applied directly to the skin, SCP-9291 has been noted to induce a calming and positive mindset on the wearer.

SCP-9292 is the small agricultural village of Innset, Norway. SCP-9292 lies on the south bank of the Faxälven river in Finnmark, consists of 36 significant man-made structures, and as of 2022 it had a population of 17 individuals. SCP-9292 includes 8 domiciles, a small grocery store, a chapel, a graveyard, and a civic center.
Every single human-made object thus far examined in SCP-9292 is anomalous in nature, as are most naturally occurring objects (wildlife, plantlife, rocks, etc). Objects in S

SCP-9293 is a 100-meter1 reinforced concrete cube partially embedded in the ground in Homewood, Birmingham, Alabama. SCP-9293 manifested suddenly on September 2, 2025, at 06:00. Prior to this, the location of SCP-9293 was occupied by 9 full and 3 partial single-family households on Maple Street and Roseland Drive.2
While SCP-9293 is stable, its concrete is of low, flaky quality, and its rebar is in a severe state of rust. As such, it can easily be penetrated, but care must be taken not to distur

SCP-9294 is an anomalous species with potent cognitohazardous properties. SCP-9294 instances resemble large, bipedal insects. They typically stand 2.0-2.5 meters upright and weigh 60-80 kilograms. SCP-9300 is a perfect blackbody located within the Tabby's Star system, approximately 1,500 light-years from Earth. A blackbody is an object that absorbs all radiation directed towards it, reflecting none of it. Typically, they will heat up as their energy increases and emit their own thermal radiation. The blackbody orbits Tabby's Star at a distance of approximately 0.83 AU2.

SCP-9302 refers to the active vampire population of Eschar, Tennessee.

SCP-9305-1 instances lose the capability to form memories while affected by SCP-9305, resulting in drivers not remembering what occurred between the beginning and end of their shift.

Both the site and the Foundation's existence are well-known, and are integral to the history of the area, as it is the largest employer in the city with 1.1 million personnel.1

Its face and hands are the only parts which remain uncovered. It has been observed to possess iridescent white skin which makes these appendages typically exceptionally visible. No description has been obtained of its face, beyond that is distressing to all subjects on first observation.

The SCP-9312 phenomenon refers to an oddity recorded by the fortune-telling and occult community several times since the 1990s. For the majority of its recorded existence, it was dismissed as a negative visualization or imitation of notable prophecies. With the advent of the internet and the easier access to communication that came from it, SCP-9312's existence would shift from an occasional mention to a source of debate for occultists and mediums in online forums.

SCP-9313 refers to a CRT television set that fails to display when powered on. Despite this, individuals who look upon the screen of SCP-9313 will claim the item does function, and is tuned to an out-of-service channel. This anomalous effect can be neutralized through resistance to psionic influence or by assuring oneself of their juvenescence.

SCP-9314 is, allegedly, the personal office of the Administrator. According to assorted rumors and institutional folklore, the office is located on one of Site-19's abandoned sublevels, but anyone who finds it can only do so once. These same stories claim that a person who enters the office may ask the Administrator a single question about the Foundation, which he will answer fully and honestly.

SCP-9315 is an apple pie measuring 30 centimeters in diameter that possesses the ability to transmute other forms of matter into itself through direct contact. The transmutated material retains the same properties as the original anomaly, allowing the anomaly to "spread" at a exponential rate. No upper bound on this rate of conversion is known to exist.

SCP-9316 is an approximation of the London Natural History Museum, located exactly 1km below the original. Whilst originally regarded as part of SCP-1678, recent findings have warranted for it to receive its own item number.

data.descriptionExcerpt: SCP-9317 is a large, highly complex paratechnological structure designed to create, stabilize, and sustain a Wynn-Paxton Mortal-Deific Interactivity Gateway. SCP-9317 is currently functional and in an inactive state.

SCP-9318 is purportedly a Foundation subsidiary headquartered in Merthyr Tydfil, Wales. Existing records are analogue in nature, dating back to 1979, placing it under the remit of the Post-Disposal Processing Division (PDPD). This department has not existed for 50 years.
Despite this, the industrial grounds of SCP-9318 still operate from a secluded location within a local coniferous forest. Written atop the entrance gate are the words “ANIMAL HOSPITAL” on a yellow plastic plaque. Deliveries of d

SCP-9319 is a loosely-connected series of concepts in the noosphere pertaining to an individual that does not exist. When collected and considered in full, the constructed narrative indicates that they pertain to Arjan Devi, age 26, a resident of Albany, New York. This individual does not exist on any government records, and is currently survived by oral histories, memories, and unofficial, physical keepsakes. Instances of SCP-9319 are anomalously persistent, and have survived multiple attempts

SCP-9320 is the language used by presumably all species of tree. Initially thought to be anomalous due to a prior lack of evidence supporting the idea of plant intelligence, Foundation research has concluded that the language is, in fact, entirely ordinary, as all of the biological processes used to construct the language are already known to mundane science.
SCP-9321 is an abandoned Khrushchevka apartment, located in Корлики (Korliki), that displays anomalous properties akin to the physiology and behaviour of plants.

Regardless of how feeble SCP-9323 may appear, it has strength on par with a modern off-road terrain automobile and is capable of breaking through walls of its own volition. As a result, once daily at 0800 hours local time, SCP-9325 spontaneously manifests and de-manifests above random portions of American airspace. It is currently unknown how SCP-9325 remains actively airborne; only one untrained passenger is aboard, designated SCP-9325-1.

This occurs once SCP-9326 passes within 1 angstrom1 of the bond between a targeted pair of atoms. SCP-9326 appears to cause a phase-shift between bonded atoms, causing all bonding orbitals to move destructively out-of-phase into their respective anti-bonding forms.

No producer, manufacturer, or distributor are listed anywhere on SCP-9327's case, and its origin remains unknown. Islands affected by SCP-9344 evolve towards a specific template, with changes occurring to their geography, settlement, businesses, and population according to a regular pattern. All samples collected from SCP-9345 regenerate almost immediately after tissue is removed; the limits of this regeneration have not been tested due to the value of the anomaly and concerns about inflicting irreparable damage.
SCP-9345’s main anomalous effect is triggered when a drop of human blood is introduced in its mouth.

All is wrong. I will open its containment chamber and the world will be as it should be, and none will have noticed that they forgot it to begin with. Originating from the Porthleven post-visitation zone discovered in 1993. The cause of SCP-9515’s generation is as of yet unknown. Its exact size and location are as of yet indeterminable. SCP-9515 is a manifold with no dimensions, lacking both perimeter and volume.

SCP-9517 is an oblate spheroidal area with a polar diameter of about 70.90 pc and an equatorial diameter of about 70.72 pc. It is located in the constellation Scorpio at RA: 17h 31m 4s, Dec: -37° 11' 21" in epoch J2000.0, at a distance of about 4.51 kpc from the Solar System.

SCP-9518 is a phenomenon that occurs within commercial sportsbooking and prediction marketplace platforms, wherein bets placed will alter reality in such a way that the bets placed become successful.
Object is an extremophilic species of yeast, capable of partially fermenting any liquid it exists in via enigmatic chemical means.

SCP-9520 is a spheroid mass of photosynthetic, cephalopod-like tentacles. It is capable of mimicking the appearance of other entities by self-transfiguration; while mostly identical, these mimics will possess a varying number of imperfections, such as suckers and geometric patterns where limbs, eyes, and/or other external organs would be.

SCP-9525 is a window that measures 61.0 centimeters wide and 91.4 centimeters high. SCP-9525 shows its observer a visual of a monotone, dark, empty space. SCP-9525 reflects light as silicon dioxide glass does.

SCP-9527 was discovered by a Foundation expedition beneath the Antarctic ice sheet, within a permanently enclosed saltwater lake cavity formed by a geological anomaly. No visible entrance to the cavity exists.

The interior of SCP-9530 constitutes a pocket dimension of unknown size, though generally manifesting as a set of rooms that would be expected of a skyscraper or equivalent urban building, extending upwards to an undetermined distance. The first aspect of the anomaly is in effect from sundown until sunrise. During this time, anomalous entities and objects are drawn by an unknown mechanism to loiter outside or patronize Sizzle City Pancakes locations. SCP-9543 instances vary in size and color—most instances have been observed to be either orange, brown, black, or white—though all maintain a compact, rounded structure. Though this form frequently varies in height, build, hair colour, sex, and ethnicity, it always wears a black business suit, white shirt, black clip-on tie, black dress shoes, black sunglasses, black leather gloves, and an earpiece with the cable fitted into the collar.

SCP-9546 resembles a worn sock puppet with brown button eyes and a crudely stitched mouth. Numerous sections of the fabric have been repaired with mismatched patchwork. SCP-9546 wears a miniature jester costume and emits a persistent smell of decomposition. Unidentified stains are present along the lower portion of the object.

SCP-9547 is an anomalous immune response created when individuals come into contact with anomalous materials, hereafter referred to as "triggers". An individual that displays an SCP-9547 response to one trigger may not display it for others. While exact numbers are not known, it is estimated that SCP-9547 is displayed by around 2% of the human population.

SCP-9549 is an anomalous location masquerading as SCP Foundation Area-45. There are two facilities presently responding to this designation, both equipped with a Director and small support staff, but Foundation records attest to the construction of only one. Due to a suspicious loss of electronic documentation, it is not known which facility is legitimate and which is not.

SCP-9555 is the fifth sublevel of Foundation Site-41. At an unknown point prior to 1990, all conventional methods of entry into SCP-9555 were disabled: staircases were blocked off with concrete, and elevators were modified to no longer access sublevel 5. It can still be accessed through elevator shafts, and by small objects via the Site-41 inter-level supply elevator on sublevel 4, but all subjects that have done so have been lost. SCP-9556 is a vinyl record identified as the 1972 album Foxtrot by the english band Genesis. SCP-9556 is indistinguishable from a standard commercial pressing, exhibiting only minor wear consistent with age. When SCP-9556 plays the last song on the record, "Supper's Ready", those who are subjected to listening exhibit acute anxiety, prophetic hallucinations, and compulsive self-harm ideation.

SCP-9557 is a collective designation referring to a group of 16 entities capable of mimicking materials within close proximity, currently comprised of layered cardboard, adhesive compounds and organic flesh closely resembling crab flesh. Instances vary slightly in height and weight, however they all resemble crudely cobbled together human figures supported by wooden framing, standing at an average height of 125cm. SCP-9559 is a massive subterranean vault complex extending beneath the foundations of Site-01. Construction is estimated to have begun in the late 16th century under the joint commission of the Thirteen Dynasties, though extant records differ on whether its purpose was containment, storage, or initiation.

SCP-9560 is made up of a rectangular base constructed from perforated steel tubes, surrounding a grey iron cast of a stylized depiction of 4 bovine mammary glands. 4 small holes are present on each udder. The cast is double bolted to the base at each corner, and has an opening to its interior on its top side. The entire structure is 1 meter tall, 1 meter long, and 1 meter wide.

SCP-9561 is a large tropical island located in the Caribbean Sea. SCP-9561 possesses an antimemetic effect, such that subjects are incapable of perceiving SCP-9561's landmass, even on satellite imagery. This antimemetic effect is removed upon seeing geographical illustrated depictions of SCP-9561 or making physical contact with its landmass.

SCP-9563 is a Class-X incorporeal ontokinetic entity currently using the alias "Charlotte". Since ████/██/██, SCP-9563 has been in a self-imposed pact of loyalty to the Foundation and its employees.

SCP-9564 is the designation for the ruins of the Lake Merritt Theater, an abandoned playhouse in the Oakland Hills, California. SCP-9568 is the unauthorized weekly broadcast of All Freaks Wrestling (AFW), a professional wrestling promotion whose roster features a variety of anomalous humanoids and entities.

SCP-9570 is the designation given to a group of 5 meta-humans that embody broad concepts in baseline reality (see Addendum 9570-A for specific concepts). They are often considered minor deities and evidence suggests they may have existed, in some capacity, since the beginning of mankind. It is believed their existence is directly tied to a fundamental link within the collective human consciousness. Loanston Furrows, TN was initially brought to the Program’s attention as pattern recognition software collated several hundred online reviews over the course of 25 years. Visitors/tourists in local hotels, B&Bs and amenity spaces consistently reported that the town was enshrouded in an intense body odour smell. This smell persisted across a majority of building interiors.

SCP-9580 is the primary scrap pile at Lehrer Brothers Recycling, a scrapyard in Welcome, MN established in 1992. After the scrap pile's anomaly was discovered in 1993, the facility was purchased from its previous owners and SCP-9580 was contained on-site.

One lobe is highly asymmetrical, consisting primarily of computing components and a variety of communications or observation devices, including a UHF radio antenna and magnetometer boom. SCP-9584 is presumed to be a Higher Tartarean Entity. Due to a memetic effect emitted by SCP-9584, no personnel have been able to provide a clear physical description of SCP-9584, though generally described characteristics include wings, a tail, and horns, common features of Tartarean Entities.

SCP-9584 is capable of high-grade thaumaturgy, flight, and is immune to all known conventional and anomalous weaponry.

Growths of SCP-9585 seem to be most concentrated underneath the shoreline, with clusters fixating on areas of dense human habitation.
SCP-9585’s lateral growth is mostly confined to a thin layer between the Sicilian bedrock and topsoil. In the rare case that a portion of SCP-9585 is uncovered by a civilian, it is almost alway

SCP-9588 is a semi-humanoid entity capable of inducing anomalous procreation in any animal. The entity's body consists of a grey trench coat, six arms, and a large mouth. It is 2 meters tall and speaks French and English.
SCP-9590 is the abandoned Rose Hill Cemetery, located 30 kilometers south of Pottsville, Pennsylvania.

SCP-9596 is a limestone cairn located in Dartmoor National Park in Devon, United Kingdom, dating back to roughly 200 B.C.E. It is perpetually in a state of partial collapse, and etchings on lower portions indicate this occurring for a prolonged, indeterminate period of time.

SCP-9612 is the remains of a bonfire, located in a remote, forested area in [REDACTED], Ohio, USA. The structure is roughly 2.2 meters tall, with a 2x2-meter base. It was constructed in July of 1967.

The item wears minimal antique clothing, and thin barbed wire extends up from its neck, hands, and feet until disappearing at an uncertain point above its head. Exposed bones, rotting tissue, and a few defensive marks on the forearms are visible. It remains floating two centimeters above the ground at all times.

SCP-9616 commonly forms a dense swarm in an appropriately humanoid shape. Individual SCP-9616 members, referred to as SCP-9616-A instances, live for approximately 2 weeks, performing a form of asexual reproduction at one week of age that produces a fully grown Culex quinquefasciatus. Skin is white, with a texture similar to slightly creased paper with no signs of sexual organs or features aside from facial features. SCP-9621's eyes are two black, circular scribbles, no visible nose and a mouth that is a small, thin and black horizontal line. It has never been observed to alter its facial expression. On each hand, the entity has only four fingers, lacking thumbs. F

SCP-9622 is a recurrent dream experienced by residents of northern areas of the American state of Ohio. No pattern has been established between subjects with all residents of the affected area seeming equally likely to experience the anomaly. Memories of it are notably non-anomalous and will fade at a rate comparable to mundane dreams.

SCP-9625 is a collection of anomalous lemons that manifest from SCP-9625-1, which in turn is currently under the ownership of SCP-9625-2. Upon consumption, SCP-9625 grants the user a 20% chance to get a 10% increase in luck over the course of the next 24 hours.

On 2 NOV 2022, Researcher Arroyo became the subject of an internal Human Resources investigation following an anonymous report by his supervisor, Senior Researcher Anders Waller, who suspected Researcher Arroyo to be a Philippine naked-backed fruit bat.

SCP-9627 describes a set of plastic tiles that manifest daily at 7pm in the break room of Site-627. This set will contain 9 to 24 plastic tiles with a varying number of sides and varying dimensions. These tiles will remain in the room for approximately 2 hours before they de-manifest at around 9pm.

SCP-9631-A resembles a vending machine, with the key difference being that the contents are not visible due to the glass being replaced by another wall. All attempts to destroy, open, or observe the interior of SCP-9631-A have failed.

SCP-9636 are a species of winged insectoid predators, on average measuring 50 cm with a diameter of 2 cm, and wingspan of 1.5 cm. Select instances have been measured upwards of 4 metres long. SCP-9636 possess translucent bodies resembling nematodes with multiple sets of evenly spaced wings across their lengths. SCP-9636 possess no facial attributes or orifices. SCP-9636 travel at speeds upwards of 286 km/h. SCP-9636 is imperceptible to most animals and has only been observed through recording eq

SCP-9640 is a form of ritual execution that was performed within the ancient Daevite Empire during times of conquest. The ritual, unlike many others of Daevite origin, does not rely on the use of glyphs, ritual objects, or innate thaumaturgical ability. Instead, the ritual's success is entirely dependent on non-anomalous factors. It is of note that no anomalous compulsion to perform SCP-9640 is known to exist.

Utilizing the remains of deceased individuals and natural limestone deposits, GOI-001 was able to distill a potable fluid that trivialized or negated anomalous presence. SCP-9648 are sold in quantities of 8 in blister packs packaged singularly into cardboard boxes. Branding on the boxes proports them to have been manufactured by the Oneiroi Collective under the name "Bhava." Chemical analysis has determined the items to be sugar pills.

All SCP-9653 instances are genetically identical clones of RR-1, measuring 14 centimeters in length with a 16-centimeter tail, and weighing 150 grams.

SCP-9655 is a species of worm within the phylum Nematomorpha1. SCP-9655 possesses the unique ability to parasitise any terrestrial animal, regardless of size or anatomy.

SCP-9658 is a recurring entity that manifests as an older Caucasian male and possesses behind the Veil knowledge classified under Level 5 clearance. The first registered sighting of SCP-9658 dates to 1936, when it visited multiple settlements in Eastern Poland, encouraging the residents to build the "Capital of the World" before the "apocalypse". SCP-9660 was a targeted bioweapon deployed by the Pentagram, displaying numerous innovations in anomalous mathematics and biology that would have otherwise classified it as an eigenweapon if not for the highly localized nature of the tool, used to identify and assassinate key Foundation personnel responsible for counterintelligence and anti-espionage operations…

SCP-9663 is an anomalous Vachellia erioloba (camelthorn tree), located within South Africa's Kruger National Park. Unlike other instances of this species, the anomaly takes the form of a clonal colony,1 and forms a single multi-stem tree which covers an area of at least 6.2 hectares within the park, with the appearance of a dense wood of unique individual trees.

Subjects are still capable of unintentionally using figurative language themselves.

SCP-9679 is a 4.8 m1 tall long-case clock made of red wood and a gold-colored metal. At irregular intervals, SCP-9679 spontaneously moves itself across different locations in space and time. During such event, matter within 15 m2 are typically displaced alongside it.

SCP-9682 is a massive1 hostile entity which currently inhabits the Land of Harvest. It is quadrupedal, with each limb ending in several curved blades that can be extended and retracted at will. The SCP has a ‘SERCO’ brand mark corresponding to its place of discovery. Its internal filament consists of an unidentified material distinct from tungsten, showing an irregular structure. SCP-9690 is a humanoid male of undetermined origin. Prior to Foundation capture, he was employed as a performer in the entertainment industry.
SCP-9691 is an approximately 238 acre area in the Paimpont region of France, roughly located between SCPNAV coordinates 5426.1 and 49.852.7.

Persons affected by the phenomenon attempt to return to a Foundation Site despite total supplantation of memory relating to the Foundation and the location of its facilities.

All those attending SCP-9693, including backstage workers, on-stage performers, and audience members, spontaneously vanished multiple times during the performances of the songs "Moonage Daydream," "Memory of a Free Festival", and "It's Gonna Be Me," reappearing when the songs presumably ended. During these periods, those outside the con

SCP-9694 refers to a 755 acre waste management site located in Aurora, Colorado. The site first came to the Foundation's attention when an anonymous user uploaded a video to the 4chan board /x/, claiming that the site was "haunted" and that a network of tunnels existed below the surface.

The field of Candlestick Park is the only area affected by SCP-9695. All entities manifested by SCP-9695 are physically indistinguishable from their non-anomalous counterparts. The players and equipment manife

SCP-9697 constitutes the former official 5k cross country course at ███ ████ High School in Arizona. Historic newspaper excerpts and personal testimony from former runners alike characterize the hilly stretch as especially grueling for the sport.

SCP-9698 is 22-year-old Martin Gulch. At will, SCP-9698 is capable of physically transforming itself to take on the appearance, skills and mannerisms of renowned athlete Michael Jordan. Despite this transformation appearing biomechanical in nature, SCP-9698 does not appear to contain any mechanical components.
Despite taking on the form, skills and mannerisms of Jordan, SCP-9698 maintains the same personality and intentions.

SCP-9699 is a Foundation-made anomaly designed by the joint efforts of multiple high-level thaumaturges and imprisoned Sarkics, overseen by O5-7 and the Ethics Committee Director. Following the successful birthing of SCP-9699, all persons associated with its creation were amnesticised and released into civilian life with updated medical documentation denoting their releases a result of dissociative amnesia.
SCP-9699 itself is an anomalous humanoid of indistinguishable sex possessing the anatomy

Each SCP-9700-A instance is an inert paper map that accurately represents an anomalous site later discovered through use of associated SCP-9700-A instances. It is unknown who previously owned the instances of SCP-9700-A, or where they originated.

SCP-9701 is an anomalous member of the Leporidae familiy1 that is capable of Level 3 reality bending. The only confirmed physical details are that the entity has white fur and red eyes. SCP-9701 migrates between the Earth and the Moon regularly. This behavior is unexplained.

Each instance is structurally indistinguishable from its non-anomalous commercial counterpart. They exhibit autonomous, self-propelled locomotion and self-directed driving. Recorded metrics fluctuate in a manner not attributable to environmen

It possesses a distinct camouflage patterning across its outer shell.1 SCP-9709's outer shell also shows various signs of disrepair, including dents, nicks and an oil stain pattern consistent with long periods of field use. SCP-9790 refers to an underground structure located on the outskirts of Minsk, Belarus. The structure first came into the attention of the SCP Foundation following a review of all catalogued Foundation properties on 24/03/2020. SCP-9790 was designated as "Site-0", with a date of acquisition listed as 30/10/1961, the records of its original owner having been redacted.
SCP-9790 can only be entered through a 5 meter long metal tunnel, descending from a hatch similar in appearance to that of a bomb
SCP-9792 is a humanoid silhouette visible when reaching relativistic speed.

SCP-9795 consists of specimens from various animal species infected with a currently unknown disease. Infection results in the progressive loss of several functions and behavioral traits typically associated with the affected species. Breathing-like movements continue to occur, although no biological function has been identified.
The appearance of SCP-9795 varies depending on the infected animal. Most animals retain their original form, although some become unrecognizable and may be mistaken for

SCP-9797 is an anomalous, contagious disease affecting exclusively human subjects (referred to as SCP-9797-A) initially resembling common depressive mood disorders. Its vector of transmission is a thick black fluid generated (referred to as SCP-9797-B) by SCP-9797-A instances. SCP-9797-A subjects invariably share additive symptoms in five phases of infection (noted as SCP-9797-A-1 through -5):
Phase 1: Symptoms are mostly indistinguishable from major depressive disorder or similar mood disorders

SCP-9799 is a spectral entity resembling Ronald Bradbury, a Foundation agent who disappeared in August 1986. SCP-9799 appeared on a single occasion within Helby House, a 19th-century country house in southern Lincolnshire, England, on 2007/11/06.

SCP-9800 is the provisional designation for an anomalous event that led to the transformation of a large area of land, entirely encompassing Site-618, into a contiguous rice paddy field. Attempts to re-establish communication with the Site have been unsuccessful. With the exception of a Dr. Felix Bowie, all Site-618 personnel have been considered MIA.
A temporary outpost has been established within the vicinity of Site-618 to support investigation efforts, which are presently ongoing.
The following are a collection of facts. Not all of these facts are relevant to SCP-9801, as some have been added as obfuscation for the sake of security and personnel safety.

SCP-9802 is an outdoor air-conditioning unit which is sentient and proficient in American English. How SCP-9802 vocalizes is currently unknown, and it does not display fluency in any language except its current dialect. Otherwise, SCP-9802 is completely non-anomalous.

SCP-9803 is a phenomenon that manifests as an internet advertisement. Instances have appeared across a wide range of websites, with little correlation between site content or viewer demographic, aside from affected websites hosting low quality "chumbox"-style clickbait advertisements.
SCP-9803 consists of a picture of an individual reported missing, accompanied by crudely formatted text such as "see where they are now", or "see what they've been up to." Minor variation has been observed across m

SCP-9804 is an 80 cm long cricket bat, likely intended for use by children. It is well-worn and lacks distinctive patterns. The handle is wrapped in blue tape to improve the grip, and can be held without triggering any discernible effects. Individuals in possession of SCP-9804 are referred to as the Batter.
In order for SCP-9804 to display anomalous properties, the following must be true:

SCP-9804 must be held by the handle.
SCP-9804 must collide with an individual other than the Batter (hereby
SCP-9805 was an entity which briefly manifested during an unrelated scientific project. No other materializations of SCP-9805 have been recorded.

SCP-9806 is an anomalous manifestation of the noospheric erosion of First Nations languages of the Americas, tracked across each language's remaining population of native or fluent speakers. Its sole observable physical consequence is instances of members belonging to the taxonomical family Psittacidae1 (referred to as SCP-9806-A), discovered inside empty Foundation containment cells, storage spaces, drawers, cabinets, wardrobes or quarantine facilities, throughout both North and South American

SCP-9807 is a beige, push-button telephone. While unbranded, it is both visibly and mechanically similar to telephones used in offices during the 80's.
SCP-9807’s other anomalous effects manifest when a call is made in a sales context. Upon a caller performing a “sales pitch” for any product belonging to a brand, the receiver, now designated SCP-9807-1, becomes a regular consumer of the brand’s products. SCP-9807-1 instances have also presented elevated consumerist tendencies, as well as loyalty

SCP-9808 pertains to an Anomalous Quercus alba (White Oak) hardwood tree situated on the crown of a sparse foothill in the Monongahela National Forest in eastern West Virginia, United States of America. SCP-9808 constitutes the only known Multiversal Constant3 documented by the Multi-Foundation Coalition.
Accordingly, SCP-9808 is phenomenologically equivalent across all known iterations and manifestations. Cross-analysis with representatives of the Foundation Multiversal Consortium has regularly

Seized from HMPD evidence locker after the "Hammond Spring Parade Massacre", in which Arthur Bresnan Jr. murdered 12 people with a hunting knife. Later investigations uncovered that Bresnan Jr. was responsible for another 7 unsolved murders within Indiana, all thought to have involved SCP-9809.
Captured instance was discovered to have originated from Glamoure Costuming Shop; a subsequent raid recovered numerous other paranatural objects.

SCP-9810 is a reoccurring phenomenon across the southeastern United States in which various evangelical Protestant churches have succumbed to rapid-onset structural rot. In all cases, this rot has resulted in the total collapse of the building and the deaths of all individuals inside. As every collapse has occurred during the middle of a Sunday service, each incident has resulted in considerable fatalities.

SCP-9811 is the Foundation designation for the "Montanna [sic] Natural and Cultural History Museum." The building has three entrances: Visitors, Guests, and Staff. Only the Staff entrance appears to be inaccessible. Foundation personnel have yet to determine how to access this port; attempts to utilize other anomalies, including SCP-005, have been unsuccessful.1
Inhabiting SCP-9811 are humanoids officially designated as SCP-9811-1. These humanoids act as employees within SCP-9811 and typically c

SCP-9812 is a human ear attached to a section of grey-painted drywall. Its skin is similar in coloration to tarnished brass with notable spotting on the lobes and near the base. The lobes are droopy and larger than average, implying advanced age. It continually produces a light which passively varies between 180-200 lumens in intensity. Medical examination has determined it is continuously circulating blood. As all biological structures terminate on the point of contact with the drywall it is un

SCP-9813 designates ██ organisms which resemble King James English translations of the Christian holy text known as the "Bible." The covers are composed primarily of chitin with microscopic analysis of the pages showing they are similar in structure and composition to silk as is produced by bombyx mori (Domestic Silk Moth). Mouth parts are present at the top of the spine which also allow the item to expel waste.

+ Level 4/SINAI Security Clearance Required

- Access Granted

SCP-9814 is a wooden dining chair, measuring fifty-eight (58) centimeters in height. It is carved ornately, with traditional Chinese markings and designs engraved on it except for the seat, and coated with dark brown lacquer. Testing of SCP-9814's wood has revealed it is carved from a Japanese cherry blossom tree, and the item is not segmented into pieces, meaning it was made from a whole segment of the tree.
When a person is within SCP-9814's vicinity, around five (5) to ten (10) meters, and wi
SCP-9816 is a washing machine that explodes upon use.
SIMULACRUM

SCP-9818 refers to a phenomenon that affects workers between the ages of 16 to 65. This phenomenon occurs across a one-month time span. Subjects who are affected by SCP-9818 initially exhibit an increased productive capacity, at the cost of neglecting their own physical and mental health. As the SCP-9818 event progresses, so does a subject's obsession with productivity, opting to spend their time off continuing to work. Subjects detach themselves from their personal life, cutting off friends and

SCP-9820 is a viral phenomenon causing the organelles in the host's somatic cells1 to spontaneously exit the cell through anomalous means. This process is inevitably fatal. Upon infection, the speed of the effects will progress exponentially, with overall time taken varying from host to host. As of current research, four stages to the infection have been determined, each presenting with identifying symptoms:

SCP-9824, titled "She Was Killed", is a memetic freeware survival horror and puzzle PC video game made in the “RPG Maker VX Ace” engine, published on GameJolt1 on 03/31/2014 by user “3S2F12W23Q1W".2 SCP-9824 is downloaded alongside a non-anomalous .txt file titled "README". SCP-9824, set in Egypt, is centered around a couple, Mara and Naomi, who must solve puzzles and avoid mythological beings3 in order to escape a pyramid while being stalked by an undead Pharaoh named Eiret.

SCP-9825 is the collective designation for SCP-9825-1 and SCP-9825-2, which manifest together in random events. These events are henceforth referred to as SCP-9825 events.

SCP-9827 were 10 duplicates of a man named Garrett Matney. All drowned on the same day (December 31st, 2025) in different locations. SCP-9827 only came to Foundation attention after its neutralization, when its 10 sets of remains were all separately identified as the same individual. Further investigation of Garrett Matney's lives found no physical or documented evidence of his existence after the year 2017, with the exception of its remains and objects that were on their person(s) at time of de
SCP-9828 refers to the Red Block at the former location of Site-422, a CI2M filtration camp for civilian and military prisoners.
SCP-9830 does not exist.

SCP-9832 is a neurochemical serum that inoculates the neocortex from cognitohazardous effects. Following a study of anomalous entities resistant to these effects, Foundation researchers extracted samples of cerebrospinal fluid from these entities and cross-tested them with a sample of one-hundred D-class, documenting their effects prior to, during, and following mild cognitohazardous exposure. The data remained inconclusive until samples from SCP-████ were tested, which resulted in complete immu

Discovered following public exposure as 2005 Cedar Park mass incident, initial coverup impossible due to circumstance of incident inciting scrutiny and interference from general populace, secondary and tertiary investigative journalistic bodies obscuring site of episode. Site cleanup resulted in loss of significant assets prior to Program acquisition. Paranormal nature unclear if at all present.
Designation is the 2005 mass fatality event that occurred on fourth night of five-day ArFIX Biannual

SCP-9835 was a building located in North Wales, which operated from 2001 to 2016 under the name "The Manticore Hotel.". While in operation, SCP-9835 was a multiversal hub for anomalous activity, kept in check by GoI-119 "The Manticore Corporation". SCP-9835 appeared to only be 30m tall when observed from the outside but its true height was estimated at 3048m.
SCP-9835 currently lays in ruin, with very little of the structure remaining. Following 2016/05/23, all anomalous activity has ceased.

First brought to the attention of the Special Collections Program following an expulsion event occurring at the Providence Children's Hospital in El Paso, Texas in 1990. SCP-9838 begins, conditionally, from the rooftop of the Houston General Hospital, located in Houston, Texas. Any human subject who intentionally leaps from the roof of the building with the intent to end their own life will pass through it. The interior of SCP-9838 presents as a significantly-warped version of the Houston skylin

SCP-9839 is a form of human blood that has unusual optical properties. It is an exceptionally bright shade of red — more so than any existing pigment or any electronic display can properly replicate. SCP-9839 will continue to appear red even in the absence of red light, or in concentrations where regular blood would appear black. Details of SCP-9839's appearance are abnormally easy to discern, even at a distance or under adverse conditions.
SCP-9839 is a visual cognitohazard. Direct observers re
SCP-9840 takes the form of an adult male black-faced sheathbill (*Chionis minor*), a stocky white bird native to sub-Antarctic islands in the southern Indian Ocean.

SCP-9841 is an anti-memetic anomaly that causes increasing levels of apathy towards any given Foundation employee's career at the Foundation from their acquaintances, friends, and family members. SCP-9841 almost universally affects all acquaintances, family members, and relatives of all SCP Foundation personnel, and appears to intensify over a prolonged period of time, as long as the relevant Foundation personnel continues to be employed at the Foundation.
In a case of SCP-9841 affliction, the F
SCP-9842 was recovered from an overgrown tomb outside the Sicilian city of Syracuse.

SCP-9844 refers to a low-level, object-oriented, statically typed programming language known as ██████, originally written as a competitor to the Java programming language. SCP-9844 was created sometime between 1997 and 2003 at ████████████, a now defunct technology and software company based in Buffalo, New York. Preliminary analysis by Foundation field agents upon recovery of SCP-9844 materials from the ████████████ office in Buffalo suggests that ████████████ employees and executives were una

SCP-9848 is a pocket unwindable tape measure which kind of looks like a Stanley Powerlock 25-Foot Pocket Tape Measure. Pretty much all writing and numbering on SCP-9848 seems to be anomalously difficult to read. Attempts to capture the markings on SCP-9848 using different measurement equipment will yield differing results.1 SCP-9848 appears to gradually infect the environment around it with anomalous ontogeometric distortion unless information about it is actively obscured.2
SCP-9850 is a working pot-still distillery located in the Scottish Highlands.

Seized from Glamoure Costuming Shop in Hammond, Indiana. SCP-9853 is a two-piece, fleece and wool costume designed to resemble a yellow-furred “Easter Bunny” character. The object’s hollow interior is occupied by a mass of plaster, allowing it to maintain form.
Once every 24 hours, SCP-9853 produces a firm, oval-shaped, white mass from a hole located within the object’s ‘mouth’. While the outermost layer of these objects is chemically comparable to rubber, testing has revealed a plaster interior

SCP-9856 is a two minute long song recorded on a cassette tape. The song is sung in an unknown language by a single female voice. In the background, songbirds, wind, and footsteps are audible. When SCP-9856 is played, strawberry plants1 rapidly grow from the source of the recording. As testing is still ongoing, the full capabilities of SCP-9856 are currently unknown.



Location of SCP-9856's discovery.

SCP-9857 is a computer virus managed by Dr. Edwards, with an unknown origin. Its physical form is a metal beetle model. SCP-9857 typically activates once every 100 years. Although it has been confirmed that the anomaly is no longer active, the O5 Cou

SCP-9858 is an entity resembling a human male lacking a head. The entity has the typical build of a middle-distance runner, and wears non-branded sports wear. However an icon resembling wings is embroidered on the quarter of its sneakers

Discovered in the inventory of the Jesus Christ of Our Sorrows Clinic, Chattanooga, TN 1980. Latex male contraceptives of the Anti-Baby brand produced by Celestino Group Inc. Their peculiarity lies in an outer layer of seminal fluid derived from an unknown mammalian species, with a shelf life of two months under ambient conditions. It is capable of fertilizing humans, resulting in a corniform mole. SCP-9860 is manufactured at a facility in Chattanooga, a subsidiary of Celestino Group Inc.
SCP-9862-alpha first uploaded to file sharing website jeemsreview.██1 and later to YouTube as far back as June 2 2010, commonly titled "Fish From Hell" or variations thereof.

SCP-9863 is a condition affecting approximately 1% of people possessing severe food allergies1. Individuals affected by SCP-9863 occasionally suffer anaphylactic shock reactions consistent with their consumption of an allergen when no such allergen is present in the consumed food2. As of this writing, no means of determining when these reactions will occur has been discovered, though accumulated data has indicated the following:

Individuals affected by SCP-9863 do not experience SCP-9863 events

After the President of the UNSC calls for the members to raise their hands, an index card printed with a vote on the resolution and a comment, which is invariably a single sentence written in English, will manifest on the person of the President or one of the voting members2. SCP-9866 is a minor deity intrinsic to indigenous folklore of an isolated sub-alpine forest region within the Rila-Rhodope massif. While formerly integrated into the micro-culture of the region, public awareness of SCP-9866 has since faded into obscurity. It has accepted this status quo and expressed satisfaction with it.
Site-3J was established to leverage the isolated environment and permit long-term research into viral hazards and monitor SCP-9866 concurrently. On-site personnel are subject t

SCP-9868 is a series of small, red stickers created by Dr. Simon Webster and Researcher Elaine Parker between 2005 and 2008. When SCP-9868 is applied to an object, ownership of said object is transferred immediately to Dr. Simon Webster or Rsr. Elaine Parker, depending on who produced it. Upon removal of SCP-9868 from the object's surface, the object ceases to be owned.
The original batch of SCP-9868, numbered one through 100, was the accidental byproduct of an experiment performed by Dr. Webste

SCP-9869 is biology, a feature of the high-energy regime of the very early universe characterised by remarkable speed, adaptability, and the ability to allow complex structure and intelligence in the deeply hostile early expansion environment.

SCP-9870 is an environmental anomaly superficially similar to extreme cold. While the precise conditions needed for manifestation are not yet known, it can manifest anywhere on the surface of the Earth once the temperature falls below freezing. After a variable period of time, SCP-9870 manifestations dissipate spontaneously. No consistent conditions causing these dissipations have yet been identified. Affected environments frequently experience snowstorms and/or dense fog.
SCP-9870 prevents the

SCP-9872 is a stick of chewing gum, measuring approximately 7.0 cm in length, 1.4 width, and 0.15 cm in thickness. Recovered instances are individually enclosed in transparent polymer wrappers bearing a stylized yellow W. No manufacturer, ingredients, or other identifying information is present. Chemical analysis of recovered SCP-9872 material has identified conventional gum base, sweeteners, flavoring compounds, stabilizers, and food-grade additives. SCP-9875 is an mnestic anomaly occurring within a standard hotel room at the Horizon View Resort in Orlando. Any individuals who have previously been administered amnestics will regain suppressed memories while inside SCP-9875. However, all memories restored during exposure are lost upon exiting the room.

SCP-9876 is the designation given to a man-made device comprised of various gears, levers and pulleys, which are composed out of fossilized osseous tissues of an as-yet unidentified creature. The device measures 2 × 2 × 2 meters and is cuboid in shape. Carbon dating has placed the object's age anywhere between 65 000 000 to 67 000 000 years old.
The main anomalous property of SCP-9876 is, through a series of input commands on the device, the generation of an Einstein-Rosen bridge1 to, what can o

SCP-9877 is a repeating broadband radio transmission originating from a region of space corresponding to the star Shǎowèi. SCP-9877 was first detected in the 27th century. The signal is extremely degraded, due to severe signal attenuation and background cosmic noise. Despite this, listeners of SCP-9877 report intense feelings of safety, recognition, and "not being alone."
Analysis by the Department of Pre-Modernity has identified several snippets of pre-24th-century music, such as Johnny Be Good

SCP-9878 are a series of thaumaturgically and necromantically active Anglo-Saxon archaeological sites. They are also distinguished by their exceptionally well-preserved condition. Their anomalous properties may only be utilised by certain individuals; it is not known what criteria are used in the selection, but it is known that Prime Minister █████ qualifies for the use of all SCP-9878 instances.

SCP-9879 naturally rests in a docile state until a minimum of two humans begin conversing within the object's proximity, assumed to be the extent of the chamber. Approximately 5 to 15 seconds after the conversation began,

Its structure and material are believed to be non-anomalous in nature, as the exterior of SCP-9882 shows signs of typical aging and decay. The anomalous properties are unaffected by regular upkeep.

This capacity has been expressed through the formation of silk letters (approximately 10 cm in height) constructed from repeated thread layering. The entity has been marked by a blue dot on its abdomen, distinguishing it from non-anomalous specimens on site.

T.R. ██████ has been located in an extreme state of infection, and has been detained according to protocol. The exact origins of SCP-9885 are therefore currently unknown.

The epidermis of the subject is more elastic than that of a normal human, resulting in skin folds resembling the effects of cutis laxa. The skin also lacks many sensory neurons, including nocireceptors.

The material was impounded from a deep-sea mining operation targeting spiritual vortices in the North Atlantic Ocean. However, due to complications surrounding the project, a full yield of the material could not be obtained. As a result, an excess of 57 operatives were captured by the SCP object's effect by the year 1981. Recovery of the human assets buried in the seabed will not be attempted.
Item SCP-9887 is a dark, igneous substance that produces a paranormal effect when near a human person.

SCP-9889 is an immense arthropod resembling a stretch of asphalt road. At its death, it measured 114 meters long and 8 meters wide, with a height of just over 4 centimeters. SCP-9889 would move along stretches of road under cover of darkness, using its natural camouflaging abilities to blend in with occupied streets.
SCP-9889 was discovered on 10/4/2025, when residents of Clarence Lane in Cleveland, North Carolina reported that a large section of the street had become discolored and dislodged fr

SCP-9890 refers to perfect biological copies of recently deceased individuals. Each SCP-9890 instance is identical in every aspect to the individual it is mimicking, including retaining the individual's memories. Upon manifestation, an SCP-9890 instance attempts to establish contact with the deceased individual’s close relatives, relying on them for basic care and support consistent with typical human relationships.
As of 10-28-2025, seven SCP-9890 instances have been reported globally, designat

SCP-9891 is a humanoid entity with confirmed historical records dating prior to 1549, with documents showing that it lived among communities east of the Russian Tsardom. SCP-9891 is approximately 2.4 metres in height and possesses a thin physique. SCP-9891's respiration ranges from 5-9 breaths per minute. Initial examination upon recovery revealed that its sclerae exhibited signs consistent with conjunctival injection. The exterior of SCP-9891 is black and displays a texture consistent with sili

SCP-9892 is a red-painted slat shed with a black shingle roof located in rural Ontario, Norfolk County. SCP-9892 resides on the property belonging to Dylan Molson, who is currently being treated as a member of staff. SCP-9892's anomalous properties began manifesting on 21/05/2010, when the page listing all active Foundation sites and facilities listed Site-𝒾, which includes a list of anomalies it contains. SCP-9892-1 instances manifest digitally as Site-𝒾 on the relevant Foundation pages and for

SCP-9893 is a human female of apparent Mediterranean descent in its late 20s. SCP-9893 has several morphological differences from baseline humans, most notably a pair of black geniculate antennae 0.73 meters in length extending from its forehead. These antennae are under SCP-9893's conscious control and serve as tactile, olfactory, and gustatory organs. SCP-9893's irises and sclera are replaced by a smooth black surface of unknown function.
When supplied with a high-sugar diet, SCP-9893 is capab
SCP-9894 is a Greek male youth estimated to be approximately 17 or 18 years of age. SCP-9894 has not aged since entering Foundation custody.

SCP-9895 is a cluster of three factories (designated SCP-9895-A, -B, and -C) around Chenhu Lake (沉湖) in Guangdong Province, China. SCP-9895 produces 99.7% (2025) of all stationery equipment purchased by the Foundation Logistics Department, including writing instruments and consumables, paper products, filing and organisation equipment, adhesives and tape, and miscellaneous desk supplies.
Prior to 2020, SCP-9895 consisted of non-anomalous manufacturers operating at net profit margins of 2-4%, att

SCP-9896 is the definitive proof of the SCP Foundation's ethos and mission as discovered by the Department of Axiomatics, currently comprised of a 34 page paper. It consists of a demonstration through the fields of semantics, noospherics, metaphysics, and axiomatics.
Upon full acknowledgement of SCP-9896, there is an universal consensus regarding its verity and objectivity. It proves the mission of the Foundation is ontologically moral, justifiable, desirable, and unstoppable.

SCP-9897 is a Motorola HT 220 portable radio manufactured circa 1983 and formerly issued to emergency responders throughout North America.

SCP-9898 is a line of scar tissue in the shape of the International Date Line, the cartographic convention defining the boundary between two calendar days, present on the body of Mark Copperfore, a 40-year-old geography teacher from Auckland, New Zealand.
SCP-9898 streches from Copperfore's breast down to the bottom of his abdomen, measuring roughly 60 centimeters in length, and is positioned on the left side of his body. Aside from occasional meteoropathic pains, SCP-9898 did not cause any cons

SCP-9901 refers to a collection of 17 aerial entities, currently taking the appearance of FM-31 drones.

SCP-9902 is a gelatinous substance believed to be extradimensional1 in origin. It is dark blue in coloration and carries an odor comparable to molten acrylic plastic with a hint of blackcurrant. Due to the fact that SCP-9902's odor is carcinogenic, further olfactory analysis is inadvisable.
The mass of SCP-9902 is indeterminate; identically-sized samples have weighed anywhere between 0.4 kg and 53.92 kg depending on factors such as ambient ultraviolet light, ambient temperature, and the phases o

SCP-9903 is a spherical barrier surrounding the Sun at a radius of 1,940 AU. Though it has no effect on electromagnetic radiation entering our solar system, it absorbs all outwards emissions between the frequencies of 0.4-10.4 GHz, which constitute a large fraction of the Terrestrial Microwave Window1. It has no effect on the movement of physical matter.
SCP-9904 was a vertical leap performed by Alex Thorley on ██/██/20██ 14:12 local time.

The ritual is performed at the end of the SRA construction process, used to catalyse and pacify the internal bio-chemical mechanisms of the device, responsible for stimulating electrochemical activity.

One practitioner of thaumaturgy with a diploma in Applied Nec

The anomaly is primarily known to present among individuals hunting in pairs (with each individual given the designation, SCP-9906-1). It appears to be a prerequisite that at least one of the affected individuals has frequently visited the area alone in the weeks before their interaction with SCP-9906.

All but one managed to escape before apprehension; during questioning, the youth stated that the group was smoking a folding table, rather than tobacco or any illicit substance. These transformations are entirely at random, and occur on a global scale.

Changes made to one SCP-9924 instance are not reflected on the others, however any removal or manipulation of the material of SCP-9924 will be reversed if it goes unobserved for more than 30 seconds.

SCP-:3是一高致命性模因，主要透過書面──尤其是電子性──文字傳播。當暴露於SCP-:3之下時，對象被迫尋找一個受感染者並詢問SCP-:3是什麼。一旦對象聽了解釋後，對象進入感染SCP-:3的第二階段，它們會開始在手寫文字與打字中插入SCP-:3的複製品，表面上是為了「表達情緒」。SCP-:3有多種形態，已記錄到多達█千█百█十█種的獨特樣貌。對象會逐漸在SCP-:3的基礎型態上發展出變體，並以上面概括的標準模式散播它們。

SCP-004-J 是註冊會計師（CPA）Stanley Nichols（密西根大學，1978），為[刪除]的前首席財務官，現受聘於基金會。SCP-004-J 高約 180 厘米，重約 75 公斤，高加索人，有稀疏的棕色頭髮和棕色眼睛。實體自 1991 年 7 月被基金會收容，而表面上是應徵招聘啟事。實體的異常特性在派發對其執行強制性的低度記憶刪除程序的工作時有所表現。分配任務的員工斷然拒絕對實體執行記憶消除，聲稱 SCP-004-J 是「一個真正有遠見的人」，而且「[那]會浪費藥物，和造成不必要的資本支出。」在招聘部門和強制性與認知危容單位以及 Site-04 的危險人形生物專家的簡短會議後，作出了在聘用他們於應付賬款所需職位的前提下收容 SCP-004-J 的協定。
SCP-004-J 似乎是個非常有能力的會計師，並在降低我們的年度資本支出預算的同時為運營支出簡化了我們的供應商和採購流程作出了值得讚揚的努力。此外，他們的採購的整體方法和利用日益國際化的供應鏈，在我們對協同於創造有預算考量的交付物上之可能性的觀點上引起了翻天覆地的變化，導致眾包的範式轉變。
實體似乎短暫地在我的附近。

SCP-009-J不見了。它跑到哪裡去了？ 它在桌子下嗎？ 它在椅子上嗎？ 它在天花板上嗎？ 它在地毯底下嗎？ 它被量子鼠婦吃掉了嗎？ 它穿過隧道了嗎？ 它摔下樓梯了嗎？ 它被送回過去的嘉年華會了嗎？ 它坐火車到很遠的地方了嗎？ 它被鎖進從太空來的假信標了嗎？ 它掉進黏膠然後[資料刪除]了嗎？ 如果它堵住了水槽，我們要疏通它嗎？ SCP-009-J到底跑到哪裡去了呢？ 喔，等等，這就對了！ SCP-009-J就是你！

All specimens are mute, communicating with an unnervingly fluid manner of body language that has yet to be translated. The reason for their silence continues to elude Foundation research.

SCP-ZH-007是一隻無法被確定外型的鯊魚，並在各種多面體型態中變化。SCP-ZH-007會因情緒以及對環境的適應度改變外表，在認為自己受到威脅時會增加形體面數或增加稜角。反之，SCP-ZH-007在穩定狀態下形體在正八面體至正四面體間變動。SCP-ZH-007亦具有進入高等維度的能力，可將外表變形為非歐空間中的高維多面體。在穩定狀態下，能觀察到SCP-ZH-007的左側腹及尾部有遭受毆打痕跡，痕跡形狀為各式正多邊形。

SCP-ZH-007的多邊形變換能力有觸發SCP-ZH-289異常效應的可能。並因SCP-ZH-007的原始生存環境與本維度不同，有機會同時展現SCP-ZH-289的兩種異常效應，對接觸SCP-ZH-007此狀態的人有認知危害現象。SCP-ZH-007在遭受巨大刺激時，會將外觀轉變為█████，並製造一層現實穩定材料包覆自身。當SCP-ZH-007進入此狀態，無法透過外力或現實扭曲方式接觸SCP-ZH-007的表面，也無法透過X光分析SCP-ZH-007內部結構。

data.descriptionExcerpt: SCP-ZH-013是一組兩組具有自我複製性質的自組式木板書櫃，且複製性質僅在項目組裝完成時顯現。SCP-ZH-013的異常效應無法於組裝過程中被察覺，反覆清點已被證明是無效的。當SCP-ZH-013被組裝完畢時，參與組裝的人會於項目附近發現一個隨機的SCP-ZH-013多餘零件。組裝完成的SCP-ZH-013大部分結構無法以外力破壞，僅有與多餘部分相同的組件能遭到破壞。而SCP-ZH-013製造的多餘零件並不具有異常性質SCP-ZH-013製造的多餘零件可重新製造出與SCP-ZH-013相同的櫃子，並具有相同的異常性質。
SCP-ZH-014為一本異常的繪本，未標明作者與出版商等基本資訊。封面畫有一腰部一下具有魚類特徵的女性背對坐著，坐立於礁石上，眺望遠方的海灘，書本名稱為「美人魚杜蘭朵」；封底繪有無人的沙灘，兩個繪畫場景皆為夜晚。

SCP-ZH-015是一流竄網路中的異常現象，該現象會隨機發生在使用社群軟體進行對話時，其效應透過不合乎常理的方式展現在受影響者面前，且受影響者幾乎皆在短期內死亡，尚不確定其死因與項目是否具有直接關係。除附錄一之狀況外，基金會也曾在其他平台上蒐集到了近似的表現法。經過基金會首席電腦工程師團隊調查後，已將項目為駭客操做此一可能性刪除。由首席電腦工程師及多個基金會工程師所組成之機動特遣隊正在對項目進行搜查與研究。
SCP-ZH-016是一種直徑15厘米，高7厘米的罐頭，並附上一個透明塑膠蓋。雖然經化驗證實製造材料為錫，但是項目通體透明，光線折射率與玻璃相同。所有SCP-ZH-016的外表皆被貼上一個面積約5平分厘米，寫有「蛛網國際有限公司軍糧A31號」字樣。SCP-ZH-016內部為一個由水，微生物，藻類及田螺組成的微型生態系統，原理與生態球相近。
SCP-ZH-017為一批香港特區旅客抵港申請表，唯內容中所有「香港」字樣皆被替換成「永衡國」，標題亦被替換為「永衡國入境 事務處-入境申請表」，並且沒有班機編號/船名一欄。基金會現時收容了17份SCP-ZH-017。SCP-ZH-017皆沒有編號，有關SCP-ZH-017是以何地法律為依據而發行的研究正在進行中。
SCP-ZH-018是一張16公分x9公分的單面黑白照片，材質經檢驗後為█████有機物質，根據D級人員所描述，照片中是一位男子，年齡約██歲，身高推測███公分，經碳-14定年法後確認該照片約為1900年代初期所拍攝，但因此照片清晰度與該年代所拍攝照片不合，日後仍需再次追溯該照片之由來。
SCP-ZH-019是一部Nokia-2180手機， 背面有一外殼貼上寫有「Eric」的白色貼紙，其內部構造具活性且對應部分人類器官。藉拍攝X光片，現已觀察到的機體內結構及其所對應臟器列表如下：

SCP-ZH-020是一片位於花蓮██區的沿海海岸，以海岸為中心約百尺外的海域在夜間會發出深藍色的螢光，經化驗結果發現為一種結構類夜光藻的藻類，該藻類在海浪沖刷岸邊時會隨著站在SCP-ZH-020上的人員不同而發出各類微弱的聲音，透過多次測試後推測為該人「過去曾經聽過的聲音」，內容不限音樂或是對話，測試者皆表示對聲音擁有一種強烈的懷念感，尚無法得知該種藻類是否有自主意識，將藻類帶離SCP-ZH-020培養的結果皆以失敗告終。
SCP-ZH-021是位於臺北市██區████百貨公司七樓的廁所，內部空間廣大，與其外觀或該樓平面圖不符，不論男女廁皆具有異常效應。從外部觀察時，項目均表現出正常之廁所外觀。
SCP-ZH-022是一把長1.1m的細劍，推定於16世紀鑄造，被刺中的物體（包含活物或人員）將會獲得「無法被遺忘」的異常性質，該性質使得所有認知過該物體／人員的人將不會遺忘該實體的相關資訊，基金會的記憶消除劑也已被證實無法中和此異常性質。 我帶著這把劍去對抗他們。 項目的劍尖仍殘留血跡，由於年代久遠，血跡無法判斷來自何種生物。
SCP-ZH-023為一種具有白斑大蛾蚋(Telmatoscopus albipunctatus)外觀特徵的昆蟲，其生態習性與一般的蛾蚋存在著差異性，受精的雌蟲會自行尋找合適人類宿主以未知方式潛入額葉皮質層中產卵，期間對象不會感受到任何不適與異樣。
SCP-ZH-025為一異常實體，外型極為近似一隻純白的小型長毛家貓。項目的外觀乍看之下與一般的長毛家貓無異，但仔細觀察便會發現項目的「毛髮」明顯比一般長毛貓蓬鬆及柔軟許多，且溫度極低。項目完全由白雪組成，並被認為「質地與觸感奇佳無比」。
SCP-ZH-026是三個四面布豆袋，外有以櫻花和兔子為主題的和風刺繡。當SCP-ZH-026被用於遊戲「抓豆袋」時將會觸發其異常效應；如果SCP-ZH-026從玩家手上意外滑落，玩家附近將會出現以項目著地面繡花為主題的影像，該影像將會維持15分鐘然後消失。影像與花紋對照表如下：
SCP-ZH-027為玉宴食品調理公司的一款12顆裝蒸煮袋小籠包，其外觀、氣味、味道、口感無異常性質，當對象食用項目時未充分咀嚼，使其以完整態進入對象胃裡，項目底部會破裂並流出30~40°C的酸性液體，並以3000毫升/每小時的速率持續釋放，並在項目被分解掉或從對象體內移除時解除異常性質。
SCP-ZH-028是一種具有異常效應的衣魚(Lepisma saccharina)。SCP-ZH-028的雌性個體在產卵期時體積將會縮小－項目的直徑縮小至0.2cm，長度縮小至大約0.5cm。SCP-ZH-028每次產卵期會產出約100至150粒卵，而這些卵孵化所得出的幼蟲將會保留與他們母體產卵時相同的極小尺寸，直至成為成蟲。

SCP-ZH-029是一台位在台北龍山寺地下街商場的一台「算命機」，由一般的夾娃娃機台改造而成。其操控桿位置被替換為一觸控螢幕，具備數字以及繁體注音拼音輸入法。當SCP-ZH-029被啟動時，螢幕上會顯示需要輸入姓名、生日、性別。在輸入完成後，螢幕會變為兩個掌印，要求使用者將雙手放上。在確認雙手放上螢幕後，SCP-ZH-029會開始晃動，並且從夾娃娃機物品掉落處掉落一張寫有內容的熱感應紙SCP-ZH-029-1。
SCP-ZH-029-1上會包含一段句子，以及一項24小時內的「禁止事項」。當輸入的個人資料與一名人物完全相符，會觸發SCP-ZH-029進一步的異常效應。若被輸入資訊者遵守指示，沒有做出禁止事項，則該句子描述的情景會在輸入後24小時發生在被輸入資訊者身上；若被輸入資訊者違反了指示，則該句子描述的情景會在禁止事項遭違反後24小時，以造成傷害的方式.視不同情況有不同解釋發生在操作輸入過程的人身上。
經基金會工程部門檢驗，SCP-ZH-029的觸控螢幕與內部一個空玻璃缸相連，且在SCP-ZH-029內部不存在能夠完成上述運算的電腦或處理元件。
SCP-ZH-029在被基金會收容前
SCP-ZH-030為一副可戴在脖子上之名牌，主體為一厚5.23cm，長100cm高50cm之鐵板，繩子則以生鏽的鐵鎖鍊代替，在其正面有可書寫表面，反面則有鐵鏽、血跡與水漬。
SCP-ZH-031是一種紅色油漆，基金會現時共收容31罐，每罐500毫升至1公升不等。如SCP-ZH-031附着到任何平面超過一星期，被命名為SCP-ZH-031-1的未知品種紅色黴孢菌將會在附着的平面上滋生，其成長一共分為四個階段：
SCP-ZH-032是一白色長方體橡皮擦，其上印有灰色的「理想國文具」字樣。SCP-ZH-032表現出在使用上較無異常橡皮擦更加省力、高效率的特性，能100%拭去任何媒材在紙張上留下的痕跡。經實驗證明，無論是鉛筆、原子筆、印刷油墨、咖啡漬或是紙張的壓痕或皺褶，使用SCP-ZH-032擦拭後均能完全消除。
SCP-ZH-033是具有
SCP-ZH-034是一名為李██的中華民國籍男性，收容時1的年齡為30歲。SCP-ZH-034的精神或身體在未展現其異常的情形下，皆與正常人沒有區別。
SCP-ZH-035為一異常人形實體，外表表現為一成年亞洲男性，身高約184公分，體重約71公斤，年紀估計為2█歲，穿著灰色T恤與卡其色長褲，於其衣物正面寫有「Happy Thought」之彩色字樣。
項目為一群形似北美浣熊（Procyon lotor）的物種，該物種具有以口部啃咬方式轉化樹種性質能力，其轉化出之樹種通常可藉由一般製茶工序將其製造為茶葉。葉片帶有異常色澤，邊緣有亮色系線條存在，轉化樹種將被視為SCP-ZH-036-1並轉移至44-NB-5（地表實驗茶葉A區）收容，生食該樹種之葉片將於24小時內以未知方式死亡，但經完整製茶工序所製造茶葉可正常服用，其味道與茶湯色澤皆無異常。
SCP-ZH-037是一隻外貌正常的雌性太平洋玳瑁海龜，年齡粗估約███歲，體長0.8米，體重75公斤。SCP-ZH-037會主動進食塑膠與大部分石油類製品，而非普通玳瑁主食的海綿。SCP-ZH-037體內消化構造與普通玳瑁海龜無異，經X光確認SCP-ZH-037的確能消化石油類製品，其原理未知。
SCP-ZH-038是一種女性人體造型的展示用模型。這些人體模型不具面部特徵，頭部呈現為光滑的表面。在非活躍狀態下維持靜止的站立姿勢、雙手垂放於身體兩側。目前尚未確定人體模型的構成，材料測試中僅得出類似於玻璃纖維之結果。
SCP-ZH-039是由瑞士設計師B███████ D███████於2013年所設計的樹木造型衣帽架，由樹幹、相互分岔交錯的樹枝以及一片黑色的鐵藝底座所組成。項目以不明手段被固定在當前位置無法移動，枝幹則猶如真正的樹木般進行生長：其高度從最初收容時的175公分，至今已成長至███米，並仍持續生長中。
SCP-ZH-040為一於五月中旬左右之夜間固定出現在台灣██高中的異常現象。當項目發生時，整座██高中將會出現數十具無名屍體，並大多散落於教室內。屍檢報告顯示這些屍體皆為十六至十八歲的年紀，並皆穿著██高中之制服，但無法查出任何身份證明，制服所繡的名字也並不存在。
SCP-ZH-041為一支黑色鋼筆，初步判斷型號為萬寶龍1997文學家系列-杜斯妥也夫斯基，筆身刻有「你的夢想是什麼？」字樣。
SCP-ZH-042是一具男性屍體，資料顯示其生前姓名為「何石」，曾任茶嶺遊擊隊成員。於一九四二年夏季左右被槍殺身亡，終年36歲。SCP-ZH-042的屍體至今仍然保持完整未腐，肝溫探測長期顯示其死亡時間約為八小時前。

SCP-ZH-043-1以及SCP-ZH-043-2為正常認知中之肥皂，其上方使用了希伯萊文雕刻，似乎是復原用的奇術符號，其清潔效果與一般肥皂無異，但只要其損失之個體>=15%的時候，其便會自動分泌肥皂液體，並且切割下來的肥皂塊會成為無複製能力之子體。若失去剛好50%，則會複製產生兩個完整母體，但如果其整體完整性被破壞至整體少於5%完整，例如將其絞碎，其將消耗大量時間回覆至原先形狀，此時若使用容器固定，將可以改變SCP-ZH-043之形狀。

SCP-ZH-043於香港茶果嶺被發現，後確認SCP-ZH-043為新四山小學之物品，由於學生之疏忽導致其丟失，因此基金會要求其提供有關SCP-ZH-043之相關資料。現因實驗關係，SCP-ZH-043分別為SCP-ZH-043-1以及SCP-ZH-043-2，且SCP-ZH-043-2為實驗所產生之子實體。

SCP-ZH-044是自1997年12月15日開始，以不規則週期間歇出現於台灣地區北起新北市、南至南投縣山區道路或具邊坡地段路徑上的異常實體總稱，目前出現間隔最短紀錄為7日、最長紀錄為196日，每次生成之項目數量亦從1體至15體不等。

項目具有類似中華文化中瑞獸-“石獅子”之外觀及以四稜砂岩1為主要材質構成的身體，身長4.5至5公尺、肩高1.3至1.7公尺，並具有88至220Akiva不等之神性輻射值。項目之運動與感知能力原理不明，且常規武器難以對項目產生有效打擊。破壞項目頭部或大約35％之軀幹後項目即崩解為無異常性質之石塊，成功捕獲的項目個體亦會於3到7日內耗竭自身的神性輻射後崩解，過程無法逆轉或抑制。項目不明原因對於人類具有高度敵對性，會積極殺害其感知範圍內之所有存活人員，已觀察到項目個體彼此具有一定程度之協調性。
項目偶會生成特殊個體，於下表分述：
SCP-ZH-045為11271116罐異常調味料之總稱，項目被裝於無標籤之透明胡椒罐內。瓶身淨重量約為65公克，內部物質約為50公克。所有的SCP-ZH-045，經推算共約為56公斤重，當前剩餘約54公斤。

SCP-ZH-046是一座位於台灣新竹山區，因斷層變動而陷落損壞的神社建築。根據附近聚落和登山客的目擊情報，以及各項歷史文獻得知SCP-ZH-046建立於1900年代，並在周圍聚落與參拜人士的資助下維持約30年的運作，當時並無顯現任何異常效應。SCP-ZH-046在1935年4月時因地震而損毀，並且落入張裂的地面，有關SCP-ZH-046異常效應的相關紀錄皆於此後才被目擊或被撰寫。
當有人類進入SCP-ZH-046半徑一公里內範圍時，一名帶有微量神性輻射的人形能量團（SCP-ZH-046-1）會出現於該名進入者面前，向進入者提出前往神社的邀請。SCP-ZH-046-1無法與環境產生實質互動，亦無攻擊性。在探索SCP-ZH-046下方的裂谷時，於其中發現大量破碎的石碑殘骸（SCP-ZH-046-2）。經重新組合後確認，石碑大小為30*45*20cm3且刻有「封」字。與SCP-ZH-046-1進行訪談，並從相關歷史資料中得知，SCP-ZH-046-2有可能為IJAMEA相關計畫中的實驗失敗品，曾具備類似現實穩定錨的功能。



SCP-ZH-046的資料照片




除了因為他人進入而出現
SCP-ZH-047為1枝仿製███公司所生產之紅色墨水0.38中性筆外貌的產品，目前個體數為28枝。不同處為墨水芯管上刻有「理想國文具製造」的字樣，以及在墨水芯管與筆管之間放有展開尺寸為30mm*25mm的印刷紙紙卷。紙卷並無異常性質，上面以普通黑色油墨印刷文字「他曾後悔過嗎？」。
SCP-ZH-048是連鎖手搖飲料「茶之魔手」位於███████████的一間分店。該店在裝潢、設備與器材選用上與一般無異常店面並無二致。

SCP-ZH-049是位於Site-ZH-14的時間異常部門 Delta-23研究區域內的一個迅子[2]恆定收容間，其門徑表面在被發現時帶有嚴重程度的金屬鏽蝕，並被人利用某種尖銳器具刻上一個呈二十五格狀的回文陣[3]。已知有關該收容間的建造歷史早在Site-ZH-14的初步建立之時（1979年末）就已存在。但是基金會並未在當初的建設藍圖上發現到與SCP-ZH-049相關的空間規劃設計，而時間異常部門人員似乎早已知曉了SCP-ZH-049的存在，並提供相關的文件記述以及對SCP-ZH-049-Prime的片段記述資料。



根據時間異常部門人員的說法以及對這些文件的後續分析，SCP-ZH-049似乎是時間異常部門曾經在平行時間內，所自主研發的一個未知性設施，並會在所有平行時間線的現實中，同步建立其已存在的客觀事實，且這種客觀事實不會被自身存在的先提條件給束縛住、或是產生悖論。



當前猜測SCP-ZH-049能夠造成一個對基金會本身有利的因果循環，並會永久附加在位於SCP-ZH-049內部的所有活物及非活物身上，而在理論中的SCP-ZH-049若符合所有其需具備的理想條件，則會對上述
SCP-ZH-050一把███文具出產的異常文書用美工刀。項目之塑膠外殼為藍色，在背面握柄有部分掉漆，其刀片具有些微鏽蝕，且刀口有小幅度的損傷，但不影響使用。更換任何零件皆會導致SCP-ZH-050失去異常效應。
SCP-ZH-051為一系列異常接觸事件，該事件只在下列因素滿足時有機率觸發.當前人為觸發實驗皆以失敗告終。。

data.titleJP: 忘了我吧，但我不會忘記你們的
data.descriptionExcerpt: SCP-ZH-052是新北市三峽區華樹高中第22屆至第24屆全體師生共同擁有的一段異常不明記憶。項目表現為和「二班第14號男同學」有關的記憶異常，所有受影響者皆認為自身擁有和此人相關的互動記憶，卻無法記起項目的長相、姓名、特徵，也無法正確憶起項目在記憶中的表現。儘管如此，所有受影響者一致認為項目是非常重要的一段記憶，並在2021年4月發現此一異常記憶現象，引起媒體關注後由基金會介入調查。
SCP-ZH-053現時是位於台灣台南市██區的一座仿歐式溫室花園，為1982年被基金會發現的一間廢棄養豬場之下的化糞池，經多年後改建成一間溫室花園。SCP-ZH-053將會影響範圍內所有物件與人員，當中許多物件皆被觀察到有多種難以預測之異常效應，一些效應正在被討論是否能用於協助收容與作為醫療用途。
SCP-ZH-054為一根香蕉，品種未知，長度約為15公分，項目外表上與一般香蕉無異，不同的是該項目不會進行熟成，且具有語言能力，項目聲音類似男性，經X光檢查後未找到發聲器官，項目能以未知的方法感知周圍的環境。經過測試，項目的智力略高於一般成人，認知上明白自身是一根香蕉，儘管如此，項目仍對於大多數香蕉被用於食用並不知情。實驗證明項目無法受到損傷。

data.titleJP: 做你自己的主廚，隨時隨地開動吧！
data.descriptionExcerpt: SCP-ZH-055為一本異常書籍，A4規格，封面與封底皆為乾淨的米色，於封面上方以黑色麥可筆寫有「安布羅斯石榴行動分館——做你自己的主廚，隨時隨地開動吧！」字樣，並印上數種料理的圖樣作為封面照片。圖樣應為普通的家常料理，但考慮到書籍內容與異常效應，因此難以判斷圖樣描述之確切料理內容。
SCP-ZH-057是一顆曾經位於本太陽系主小行星帶中的小行星A-1764，在發現異常性質後基於[已刪減資料]由美國航太總署（NASA）移交給基金會管理。SCP-ZH-057的直徑大約5公里，物理組成包含37%的矽酸鹽類物質、26%的鐵、28%的鎳與9%的其餘物質，為一枚石鐵隕石。SCP-ZH-057的重量預估為550億公噸，現已無法得知實際數據。

SCP-ZH-058是位於高雄市天廈大飯店內的一處維度異常，僅能由該建物的第十二樓往頂樓天台的樓梯進入。SCP-ZH-058僅會在每日的03:30到04:15期間出現，且只有當日第一次打開天廈大飯店十二樓樓梯間頂端的逃生門後才會顯現。直至隔天同一時段之前，任何再次打開此逃生門的嘗試都無法通往SCP-ZH-058。該維度內部主要為一條往兩側延伸的走廊，格局與裝潢風格與其他樓層有顯著的落差。走廊兩側有大量與其他樓層相似的房門與走廊設施（如消防栓、逃生出口、電燈開關等），然而，所有的房門都無法開啟或被破壞。所有位於走廊兩側的設施都沒有實質上的作用。試圖對SCP-ZH-058建築結構造成的任何損壞都會以不明方式瞬間還原，至今尚無法觀察到此維度的任何「外部」結構。
SCP-ZH-058的空間長度顯然與天廈大飯店的其他樓層構造不符。事實上，往該走廊的「盡頭」前進被認為「幾乎是徒勞無功的」；光學與聲納測距方法皆顯示該走廊的盡頭和SCP-ZH-058的入口之間僅有130公尺的距離，然而，在SCP-ZH-058中的任何地點都能取得一致的結果——甚至在探索隊伍實際步行超過130公尺以上的距離後仍然如此。即

SCP-ZH-059是一間位於Site-ZH-██北側，編號288的D級人員觀察間。與該設施中其他D級人員觀察間相同，SCP-ZH-059設有一面觀察用單向鏡，並額外增設了一張單人床、一張金屬桌、一張金屬椅以及一盞桌燈。上述器物皆固定於牆面、桌面或地面上。
SCP-ZH-059會於當地時間每日中午十二時，以未知的方式進行內部清潔，清潔項目包含天花板、牆面、地面，以及桌、椅、床板的清掃、擦拭。從清潔後的表面進行成份分析，確認用於清潔的溶劑為Site-ZH-██普遍使用的清潔劑以及水。
在上述時間以外，若SCP-ZH-059中有任何因人為因素而掉落、遺留的物品，SCP-ZH-059會立刻試圖清除掉落物，而傾倒於SCP-ZH-059內部的液體則會以迅於自然蒸發的速度消失。SCP-ZH-059的物品清除能力視該物品的大小、用途和髒亂程度而變化。

SCP-ZH-060是發生在花蓮縣鹿路隧道中的一系列異常現象活動的總稱。當人員在午夜時間（通常是12:00至4:00左右，時間不精確固定）駕駛車輛進入鹿路隧道，且整條隧道中只有該車輛1，SCP-ZH-060將有可能發生。在車輛符合該隧道車速限制的情況下，約需要駕駛七分鐘才能開過整條隧道。當SCP-ZH-060發生時，整條鹿路隧道內大部分的電器將會失效，包含攝影機、手機、隧道燈光等，但錄音機和車輛依然能夠正常運作。
SCP-ZH-062是一個傳統台灣燈鉤（又稱為燈猴）。性質分析指出項目製造於1889到1897年間，本體為竹製品，但其表面相當均勻的覆蓋有一層厚度約1毫米的金原子，使得其重量有顯著的增加。這些黃金能夠被暫時刮除，但會以不明的方式重新還原到均勻覆蓋的狀態。當前推測此現象是某種民俗性奇蹟術的結果。

data.titleJP: 歡 笑 不 再

data.descriptionExcerpt: SCP-ZH-064 為同時具備部分植物及動物特徵的不明生物，身高 120 公分，身體構造大致上可區分為頭部、軀幹以及由軀幹底部延伸的十二隻觸手。面部具有四對光學感測器(功能似眼睛)，以垂直方向排成兩列。
SCP-ZH-065是一罐葡萄乾，每次取用俱以不明原理生成相應質量的葡萄乾以作補充。

SCP-ZH-066為一本外觀無異常的書本，尺寸為標準32開（12.8 x 19 x 1.5公分），由黑色皮革書皮與235頁銅版紙書頁組成。項目封面與封底皆沒有印刷，經檢驗發現書皮之皮革由人皮製成。項目內頁由繁體中文撰寫，內容描述多個人類與多個被描述為「邪神」的未知神性實體之相互交流、殺戮、以及大量性交場面，其中疑似包含SCP-███、SCP-████、以及SCP-ZH-███。內容描寫細膩，並被大部分閱讀者描述為「詭異」、「殘忍」、或者「令人毛骨悚然」。由於閱讀項目內容的電子掃描版本不會觸發項目之異常效果，可推測項目內容與項目本身之異常性質無關。
以手部接觸項目的人員將會不自覺的翻閱項目。當沒有其他處於第一或是第二階段之066-1個體存在時，若有人員閱讀項目，該人員將會受到項目影響，並被編為SCP-ZH-066-1。066-1將展現的行為可被分為三個階段，各階段之表現如下：

SCP-ZH-067是一座於2019年發現的地下異常結構物。項目位於索馬利蘭共和國1哈爾格薩的拉斯·吉爾岩壁畫群2洞窟正下方的隱藏地穴，該處與拉斯·吉爾沒有直接連通結構，必須由基金會在兩公里外開鑿的額外通道（Site-ZH-134）前往。項目為一個位於地穴中的半橢圓球狀封閉結構，長軸直徑約為25公尺、短軸約為22公尺，高度[已刪減] 在地穴底部往上顯現的半球高度約14公尺。SCP-ZH-067整體上呈現半球狀，在縱軸上的一側較為低矮平緩，定義為該結構物的「前側」，而較高陡、圓弧的一側被定義為結構物的「後側」，以此判別項目的左右。在縱向（最長端）方向有一明顯的顯著凹陷，形成一溝槽。這段溝槽的深度大約為半圓球表面深入7公尺，其縫隙寬度不足一個人類側身進入探索。此外，在項目雙側的短軸附近有一相對中央縱溝更小的圓弧狀側溝。即便項目的組成質地與周遭環境的地質沒有顯著差異，用肉眼仍然可以看出項目表面已經（相對於周遭環境的）相當光滑，部分表面則是由鈹青銅合金組成，尤其集中在縱軸左側方的一小塊區段。這些鈹青銅合金的厚度約在15公分到1公尺之間，上面刻有多種與已知常態或異常文明都不相符的記號與刻痕，按照
SCP-ZH-068是一種發生在高速公路上的濃霧事件，事件發生前，該區域的天空將呈現「青鈍色」。

SCP-ZH-069是一起異常現象之總稱，該異常只會於台灣本島地區出現。當一人類於台灣本島境內永久或即將長時間與其主觀認定之寵物或具有類似情感之物品分離後，將成為潛在的SCP-ZH-069-1。
SCP-ZH-069-2為一輛██牌██████型號黑色汽車SCP-ZH-069-2為一輛或多輛異常交通工具之總稱，該月之SCP-ZH-069-1人數小於三時將以██牌██████型號黑色汽車出現，項目之車牌似乎為隨機產生，並且未曾符合任何已登記之牌照。在2015/█/██後已確認能以其他交通工具之外貌出現，目前尚未觀測到SCP-ZH-069-2以非車輛之外貌出現。
當SCP-ZH-069-1之數量大於三時，SCP-ZH-069-2將以能承載該人數之車輛類型出現。
SCP-ZH-069-2出現時，其面對SCP-ZH-069-1的窗戶將會降至最底，並於窗口探出一物體，表現為與SCP-ZH-069-1於該月內分離的寵物（以下稱為SCP-ZH-069-3），且不限於活物。
當SCP-ZH-069-1觀測到SCP-ZH-069-2後，SCP-ZH-069-2會於該SCP-ZH-069-1面前停下，面對
SCP-ZH-070為一異常亞洲男性人型實體，居住地為台灣，年齡為24歲，高1.74公尺，重114.2公斤，姓名為███，外型除過重外無異常之處。情緒管理方面需要控管且道德倫理方面可能具有嚴重偏差，曾對研究人員抱持敵意並嘗試攻擊。
SCP-ZH-071是位於[已編輯]山區的一段廢棄公路，該路段由於落石危險自1988年以來被關閉。自1995年以來，SCP-ZH-071路面上會以大約兩年一次的頻率發生顯現事件，在該事件中會出現公車殘骸，並且每次車中包含十三具屍體。這些殘骸被編列為SCP-ZH-071-Av1，而乘客屍體則編列為SCP-ZH-071-Ap2。

SCP-ZH-072為Site-ZH-02內的自09/10/2020起連串非常規事件的組合，包括但不限於：

額外的瀏覽紀錄
